GEN.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Gen" sID="gen2" type="book"/> <milestone n="Genesis" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Genesis" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Gen" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Genesis</title> <div sID="gen3" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Gen.1" sID="Gen.1"/>
viditque Deus cuncta quae fecit et erant valde bona et factum est vespere et mane dies sextus <chapter eID="Gen.1"/><div eID="gen3" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen4" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Gen.2" sID="Gen.2"/>
erant autem uterque nudi Adam scilicet et uxor eius et non erubescebant <chapter eID="Gen.2"/><div eID="gen4" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen5" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Gen.3" sID="Gen.3"/>
eiecitque Adam et conlocavit ante paradisum voluptatis cherubin et flammeum gladium atque versatilem ad custodiendam viam ligni vitae <chapter eID="Gen.3"/><div eID="gen5" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen6" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Gen.4" sID="Gen.4"/>
sed et Seth natus est filius quem vocavit Enos iste coepit invocare nomen Domini <chapter eID="Gen.4"/><div eID="gen6" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen7" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Gen.5" sID="Gen.5"/>

et facti sunt omnes dies Lamech septingenti septuaginta septem anni et mortuus est Noe vero cum quingentorum esset annorum genuit Sem et Ham et Iafeth <chapter eID="Gen.5"/><div eID="gen7" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen8" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Gen.6" sID="Gen.6"/>
fecit ergo Noe omnia quae praeceperat illi Deus <chapter eID="Gen.6"/><div eID="gen8" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen9" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Gen.7" sID="Gen.7"/>
obtinueruntque aquae terras centum quinquaginta diebus <chapter eID="Gen.7"/><div eID="gen9" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen10" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Gen.8" sID="Gen.8"/>
cunctis diebus terrae sementis et messis frigus et aestus aestas et hiemps nox et dies non requiescent <chapter eID="Gen.8"/><div eID="gen10" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen11" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Gen.9" sID="Gen.9"/>
et impleti sunt omnes dies eius nongentorum quinquaginta annorum et mortuus est <chapter eID="Gen.9"/><div eID="gen11" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen12" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Gen.10" sID="Gen.10"/>
hae familiae Noe iuxta populos et nationes suas ab his divisae sunt gentes in terra post diluvium <chapter eID="Gen.10"/><div eID="gen12" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen13" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Gen.11" sID="Gen.11"/>
et facti sunt dies Thare ducentorum quinque annorum et mortuus est in Haran <chapter eID="Gen.11"/><div eID="gen13" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen14" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Gen.12" sID="Gen.12"/>
praecepitque Pharao super Abram viris et deduxerunt eum et uxorem illius et omnia quae habebat <chapter eID="Gen.12"/><div eID="gen14" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen15" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Gen.13" sID="Gen.13"/>
movens igitur Abram tabernaculum suum venit et habitavit iuxta convallem Mambre quod est in Hebron aedificavitque ibi altare Domino <chapter eID="Gen.13"/><div eID="gen15" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen16" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Gen.14" sID="Gen.14"/>
exceptis his quae comederunt iuvenes et partibus virorum qui venerunt mecum Aner Eschol et Mambre isti accipient partes suas <chapter eID="Gen.14"/><div eID="gen16" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen17" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Gen.15" sID="Gen.15"/>
et Amorreos et Chananeos et Gergeseos et Iebuseos <chapter eID="Gen.15"/><div eID="gen17" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen18" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Gen.16" sID="Gen.16"/>
octoginta et sex annorum erat quando peperit ei Agar Ismahelem <chapter eID="Gen.16"/><div eID="gen18" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen19" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Gen.17" sID="Gen.17"/>
et omnes viri domus illius tam vernaculi quam empticii et alienigenae pariter circumcisi sunt <chapter eID="Gen.17"/><div eID="gen19" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen20" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Gen.18" sID="Gen.18"/>
abiit Dominus postquam cessavit loqui ad Abraham et ille reversus est in locum suum <chapter eID="Gen.18"/><div eID="gen20" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen21" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Gen.19" sID="Gen.19"/>
minor quoque peperit filium et vocavit nomen eius Ammon id est filius populi mei ipse est pater Ammanitarum usque hodie <chapter eID="Gen.19"/><div eID="gen21" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen22" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Gen.20" sID="Gen.20"/>
concluserat enim Deus omnem vulvam domus Abimelech propter Sarram uxorem Abraham <chapter eID="Gen.20"/><div eID="gen22" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen23" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Gen.21" sID="Gen.21"/>
et fuit colonus terrae Philisthinorum diebus multis <chapter eID="Gen.21"/><div eID="gen23" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen24" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Gen.22" sID="Gen.22"/>
concubina vero illius nomine Roma peperit Tabee et Gaom et Thaas et Maacha <chapter eID="Gen.22"/><div eID="gen24" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen25" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Gen.23" sID="Gen.23"/>
et confirmatus est ager et antrum quod erat in eo Abrahae in possessionem monumenti a filiis Heth <chapter eID="Gen.23"/><div eID="gen25" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen26" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Gen.24" sID="Gen.24"/>
qui introduxit eam in tabernaculum Sarrae matris suae et accepit uxorem et in tantum dilexit ut dolorem qui ex morte matris acciderat temperaret <chapter eID="Gen.24"/><div eID="gen26" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen27" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Gen.25" sID="Gen.25"/>
et sic accepto pane et lentis edulio comedit et bibit et abiit parvipendens quod primogenita vendidisset <chapter eID="Gen.25"/><div eID="gen27" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen28" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Gen.26" sID="Gen.26"/>
quae ambae offenderant animum Isaac et Rebeccae <chapter eID="Gen.26"/><div eID="gen28" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen29" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Gen.27" sID="Gen.27"/>
dixit quoque Rebecca ad Isaac taedet me vitae meae propter filias Heth si acceperit Iacob uxorem de stirpe huius terrae nolo vivere <chapter eID="Gen.27"/><div eID="gen29" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen30" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Gen.28" sID="Gen.28"/>
et lapis iste quem erexi in titulum vocabitur Domus Dei cunctorumque quae dederis mihi decimas offeram tibi <chapter eID="Gen.28"/><div eID="gen30" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen31" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="Gen.29" sID="Gen.29"/>
quarto concepit et peperit filium et ait modo confitebor Domino et ob hoc vocavit eum Iudam cessavitque parere <chapter eID="Gen.29"/><div eID="gen31" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen32" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="Gen.30" sID="Gen.30"/>
ditatusque est homo ultra modum et habuit greges multos ancillas et servos camelos et asinos <chapter eID="Gen.30"/><div eID="gen32" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen33" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Gen.31" sID="Gen.31"/>
Laban vero de nocte consurgens osculatus est filios et filias suas et benedixit illis reversus in locum suum <chapter eID="Gen.31"/><div eID="gen33" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen34" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Gen.32" sID="Gen.32"/>

quam ob causam non comedunt filii Israhel nervum qui emarcuit in femore Iacob usque in praesentem diem eo quod tetigerit nervum femoris eius et obstipuerit <chapter eID="Gen.32"/><div eID="gen34" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen35" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Gen.33" sID="Gen.33"/>
et erecto ibi altari invocavit super illud Fortissimum Deum Israhel <chapter eID="Gen.33"/><div eID="gen35" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen36" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Gen.34" sID="Gen.34"/>
responderunt numquid ut scorto abuti debuere sorore nostra <chapter eID="Gen.34"/><div eID="gen36" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen37" type="x-p"/><chapter n="35" osisID="Gen.35" sID="Gen.35"/>
consumptusque aetate mortuus est et adpositus populo suo senex et plenus dierum et sepelierunt eum Esau et Iacob filii sui <chapter eID="Gen.35"/><div eID="gen37" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen38" type="x-p"/><chapter n="36" osisID="Gen.36" sID="Gen.36"/>
dux Mabdiel dux Iram hii duces Edom habitantes in terra imperii sui ipse est Esau pater Idumeorum <chapter eID="Gen.36"/><div eID="gen38" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen39" type="x-p"/><chapter n="37" osisID="Gen.37" sID="Gen.37"/>
Madianei vendiderunt Ioseph in Aegypto Putiphar eunucho Pharaonis magistro militiae <chapter eID="Gen.37"/><div eID="gen39" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen40" type="x-p"/><chapter n="38" osisID="Gen.38" sID="Gen.38"/>
postea egressus est frater in cuius manu erat coccinum quem appellavit Zara <chapter eID="Gen.38"/><div eID="gen40" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen41" type="x-p"/><chapter n="39" osisID="Gen.39" sID="Gen.39"/>
nec noverat aliquid cunctis ei creditis Dominus enim erat cum illo et omnia eius opera dirigebat <chapter eID="Gen.39"/><div eID="gen41" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen42" type="x-p"/><chapter n="40" osisID="Gen.40" sID="Gen.40"/>
et tamen succedentibus prosperis praepositus pincernarum oblitus est interpretis sui <chapter eID="Gen.40"/><div eID="gen42" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen43" type="x-p"/><chapter n="41" osisID="Gen.41" sID="Gen.41"/>
omnesque provinciae veniebant in Aegyptum ut emerent escas et malum inopiae temperarent <chapter eID="Gen.41"/><div eID="gen43" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen44" type="x-p"/><chapter n="42" osisID="Gen.42" sID="Gen.42"/>

at ille non descendet inquit filius meus vobiscum frater eius mortuus est ipse solus remansit si quid ei adversi acciderit in terra ad quam pergitis deducetis canos meos cum dolore ad inferos <chapter eID="Gen.42"/><div eID="gen44" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen45" type="x-p"/><chapter n="43" osisID="Gen.43" sID="Gen.43"/>
sumptis partibus quas ab eo acceperant maiorque pars venit Beniamin ita ut quinque partibus excederet biberuntque et inebriati sunt cum eo <chapter eID="Gen.43"/><div eID="gen45" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen46" type="x-p"/><chapter n="44" osisID="Gen.44" sID="Gen.44"/>
non enim possum redire ad patrem absente puero ne calamitatis quae oppressura est patrem meum testis adsistam <chapter eID="Gen.44"/><div eID="gen46" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen47" type="x-p"/><chapter n="45" osisID="Gen.45" sID="Gen.45"/>
et ait sufficit mihi si adhuc Ioseph filius meus vivit vadam et videbo illum antequam moriar <chapter eID="Gen.45"/><div eID="gen47" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen48" type="x-p"/><chapter n="46" osisID="Gen.46" sID="Gen.46"/>

respondebitis viri pastores sumus servi tui ab infantia nostra usque in praesens et nos et patres nostri haec autem dicetis ut habitare possitis in terra Gessen quia detestantur Aegyptii omnes pastores ovium <chapter eID="Gen.46"/><div eID="gen48" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen49" type="x-p"/><chapter n="47" osisID="Gen.47" sID="Gen.47"/>
et ille iura ergo inquit mihi quo iurante adoravit Israhel Deum conversus ad lectuli caput <chapter eID="Gen.47"/><div eID="gen49" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen50" type="x-p"/><chapter n="48" osisID="Gen.48" sID="Gen.48"/>
do tibi partem unam extra fratres tuos quam tuli de manu Amorrei in gladio et arcu meo <chapter eID="Gen.48"/><div eID="gen50" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen51" type="x-p"/><chapter n="49" osisID="Gen.49" sID="Gen.49"/>
finitisque mandatis quibus filios instruebat collegit pedes suos super lectulum et obiit adpositusque est ad populum suum <chapter eID="Gen.49"/><div eID="gen51" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen52" type="x-p"/><chapter n="50" osisID="Gen.50" sID="Gen.50"/>

cumque adiurasset eos atque dixisset Deus visitabit vos asportate vobiscum ossa mea de loco isto mortuus est expletis centum decem vitae suae annis et conditus aromatibus repositus est in loculo in Aegypto <chapter eID="Gen.50"/><div eID="gen52" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen2" osisID="Gen" type="book"/>

EXO.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Exod" sID="gen53" type="book"/> <milestone n="Exodus" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Exodus" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Ex" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Exodus</title> <div sID="gen54" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Exod.1" sID="Exod.1"/>
praecepit autem Pharao omni populo suo dicens quicquid masculini sexus natum fuerit in flumen proicite quicquid feminei reservate <chapter eID="Exod.1"/><div eID="gen54" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen55" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Exod.2" sID="Exod.2"/>
respexit filios Israhel et cognovit eos <chapter eID="Exod.2"/><div eID="gen55" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen56" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Exod.3" sID="Exod.3"/>

sed postulabit mulier a vicina sua et ab hospita vasa argentea et aurea ac vestes ponetisque eas super filios et filias vestras et spoliabitis Aegyptum <chapter eID="Exod.3"/><div eID="gen56" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen57" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Exod.4" sID="Exod.4"/>
et credidit populus audieruntque quod visitasset Dominus filios Israhel et quod respexisset adflictionem eorum et proni adoraverunt <chapter eID="Exod.4"/><div eID="gen57" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen58" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Exod.5" sID="Exod.5"/>
ex eo enim quo ingressus sum ad Pharaonem ut loquerer nomine tuo adflixit populum tuum et non liberasti eos <chapter eID="Exod.5"/><div eID="gen58" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen59" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Exod.6" sID="Exod.6"/>
et ait Moses coram Domino en incircumcisus labiis sum quomodo audiet me Pharao <chapter eID="Exod.6"/><div eID="gen59" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen60" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Exod.7" sID="Exod.7"/>
impletique sunt septem dies postquam percussit Dominus fluvium <chapter eID="Exod.7"/><div eID="gen60" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen61" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Exod.8" sID="Exod.8"/>
et ingravatum est cor Pharaonis ita ut ne hac quidem vice dimitteret populum <chapter eID="Exod.8"/><div eID="gen61" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen62" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Exod.9" sID="Exod.9"/>
et ingravatum est cor eius et servorum illius et induratum nimis nec dimisit filios Israhel sicut praeceperat Dominus per manum Mosi <chapter eID="Exod.9"/><div eID="gen62" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen63" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Exod.10" sID="Exod.10"/>
respondit Moses ita fiat ut locutus es non videbo ultra faciem tuam <chapter eID="Exod.10"/><div eID="gen63" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen64" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Exod.11" sID="Exod.11"/>

Moses autem et Aaron fecerunt omnia ostenta quae scripta sunt coram Pharaone et induravit Dominus cor Pharaonis nec dimisit filios Israhel de terra sua <chapter eID="Exod.11"/><div eID="gen64" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen65" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Exod.12" sID="Exod.12"/>
et in eadem die eduxit Dominus filios Israhel de terra Aegypti per turmas suas <chapter eID="Exod.12"/><div eID="gen65" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen66" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Exod.13" sID="Exod.13"/>
numquam defuit columna nubis per diem nec columna ignis per noctem coram populo <chapter eID="Exod.13"/><div eID="gen66" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen67" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Exod.14" sID="Exod.14"/>

et viderunt Aegyptios mortuos super litus maris et manum magnam quam exercuerat Dominus contra eos timuitque populus Dominum et crediderunt Domino et Mosi servo eius <chapter eID="Exod.14"/><div eID="gen67" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen68" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Exod.15" sID="Exod.15"/>
venerunt autem in Helim ubi erant duodecim fontes aquarum et septuaginta palmae et castrametati sunt iuxta aquas <chapter eID="Exod.15"/><div eID="gen68" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen69" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Exod.16" sID="Exod.16"/>
gomor autem decima pars est oephi <chapter eID="Exod.16"/><div eID="gen69" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen70" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Exod.17" sID="Exod.17"/>
quia manus solii Domini et bellum Dei erit contra Amalech a generatione in generationem <chapter eID="Exod.17"/><div eID="gen70" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen71" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Exod.18" sID="Exod.18"/>
dimisitque cognatum qui reversus abiit in terram suam <chapter eID="Exod.18"/><div eID="gen71" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen72" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Exod.19" sID="Exod.19"/>
descendit Moses ad populum et omnia narravit eis <chapter eID="Exod.19"/><div eID="gen72" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen73" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Exod.20" sID="Exod.20"/>
non ascendes per gradus ad altare meum ne reveletur turpitudo tua <chapter eID="Exod.20"/><div eID="gen73" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen74" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Exod.21" sID="Exod.21"/>

sin autem sciebat quod bos cornipeta esset ab heri et nudius tertius et non custodivit eum dominus suus reddet bovem pro bove et cadaver integrum accipiet <chapter eID="Exod.21"/><div eID="gen74" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen75" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Exod.22" sID="Exod.22"/>
viri sancti eritis mihi carnem quae a bestiis fuerit praegustata non comedetis sed proicietis canibus <chapter eID="Exod.22"/><div eID="gen75" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen76" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Exod.23" sID="Exod.23"/>
non habitent in terra tua ne forte peccare te faciant in me si servieris diis eorum quod tibi certo erit in scandalum <chapter eID="Exod.23"/><div eID="gen76" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen77" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Exod.24" sID="Exod.24"/>
ingressusque Moses medium nebulae ascendit in montem et fuit ibi quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus <chapter eID="Exod.24"/><div eID="gen77" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen78" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Exod.25" sID="Exod.25"/>
inspice et fac secundum exemplar quod tibi in monte monstratum est <chapter eID="Exod.25"/><div eID="gen78" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen79" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Exod.26" sID="Exod.26"/>
et quinque columnas deaurabis lignorum setthim ante quas ducetur tentorium quarum erunt capita aurea et bases aeneae <chapter eID="Exod.26"/><div eID="gen79" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen80" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Exod.27" sID="Exod.27"/>

in tabernaculo testimonii extra velum quod oppansum est testimonio et conlocabunt eam Aaron et filii eius ut usque mane luceat coram Domino perpetuus erit cultus per successiones eorum a filiis Israhel <chapter eID="Exod.27"/><div eID="gen80" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen81" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Exod.28" sID="Exod.28"/>

et utentur eis Aaron et filii eius quando ingredientur tabernaculum testimonii vel quando adpropinquant ad altare ut ministrent in sanctuario ne iniquitatis rei moriantur legitimum sempiternum erit Aaron et semini eius post eum <chapter eID="Exod.28"/><div eID="gen81" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen82" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="Exod.29" sID="Exod.29"/>
et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum qui eduxi eos de terra Aegypti ut manerem inter illos ego Dominus Deus ipsorum <chapter eID="Exod.29"/><div eID="gen82" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen83" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="Exod.30" sID="Exod.30"/>
homo quicumque fecerit simile ut odore illius perfruatur peribit de populis suis <chapter eID="Exod.30"/><div eID="gen83" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen84" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Exod.31" sID="Exod.31"/>
dedit quoque Mosi conpletis huiuscemodi sermonibus in monte Sinai duas tabulas testimonii lapideas scriptas digito Dei <chapter eID="Exod.31"/><div eID="gen84" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen85" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Exod.32" sID="Exod.32"/>
percussit ergo Dominus populum pro reatu vituli quem fecit Aaron <chapter eID="Exod.32"/><div eID="gen85" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen86" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Exod.33" sID="Exod.33"/>
tollamque manum meam et videbis posteriora mea faciem autem meam videre non poteris <chapter eID="Exod.33"/><div eID="gen86" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen87" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Exod.34" sID="Exod.34"/>
qui videbant faciem egredientis Mosi esse cornutam sed operiebat rursus ille faciem suam si quando loquebatur ad eos <chapter eID="Exod.34"/><div eID="gen87" type="x-p"/>

ambos erudivit sapientia ut faciant opera abietarii polymitarii ac plumarii de hyacintho et purpura coccoque bis tincto et bysso et texant omnia ac nova quaeque repperiant <chapter eID="Exod.35"/><div eID="gen88" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen89" type="x-p"/><chapter n="36" osisID="Exod.36" sID="Exod.36"/>
et columnas quinque cum capitibus suis quas operuit auro basesque earum fudit aeneas <chapter eID="Exod.36"/><div eID="gen89" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen90" type="x-p"/><chapter n="37" osisID="Exod.37" sID="Exod.37"/>
conposuit et oleum ad sanctificationis unguentum et thymiama de aromatibus mundissimis opere pigmentarii <chapter eID="Exod.37"/><div eID="gen90" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen91" type="x-p"/><chapter n="38" osisID="Exod.38" sID="Exod.38"/>
et bases atrii tam in circuitu quam in ingressu eius et paxilli tabernaculi atque atrii per gyrum <chapter eID="Exod.38"/><div eID="gen91" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen92" type="x-p"/><chapter n="39" osisID="Exod.39" sID="Exod.39"/>

<div sID="gen93" type="x-p"/><chapter n="40" osisID="Exod.40" sID="Exod.40"/>

LEV.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Lev" sID="gen94" type="book"/> <milestone n="Leviticus" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Leviticus" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Lev" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Leviticus</title> <div sID="gen95" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Lev.1" sID="Lev.1"/>

confringetque ascellas eius et non secabit nec ferro dividet eam et adolebit super altare lignis igne subposito holocaustum est et oblatio suavissimi odoris Domino <chapter eID="Lev.1"/><div eID="gen95" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen96" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Lev.2" sID="Lev.2"/>

<div sID="gen97" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Lev.3" sID="Lev.3"/>
iure perpetuo in generationibus et cunctis habitaculis vestris nec adipes nec sanguinem omnino comedetis <chapter eID="Lev.3"/><div eID="gen97" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen98" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Lev.4" sID="Lev.4"/>

omnem quoque auferens adipem sicut auferri solet adeps arietis qui immolatur pro pacificis et cremabit super altare in incensum Domini rogabitque pro eo et pro peccato eius et dimittetur illi <chapter eID="Lev.4"/><div eID="gen98" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen99" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Lev.5" sID="Lev.5"/>

<div sID="gen100" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Lev.6" sID="Lev.6"/>

hostia enim quae caeditur pro peccato cuius sanguis infertur in tabernaculum testimonii ad expiandum in sanctuario non comedetur sed conburetur igni <chapter eID="Lev.6"/><div eID="gen100" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen101" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Lev.7" sID="Lev.7"/>

<div sID="gen102" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Lev.8" sID="Lev.8"/>

<div sID="gen103" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Lev.9" sID="Lev.9"/>

<div sID="gen104" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Lev.10" sID="Lev.10"/>

<div sID="gen105" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Lev.11" sID="Lev.11"/>

<div sID="gen107" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Lev.13" sID="Lev.13"/>
ista est lex leprae vestimenti lanei et linei staminis atque subteminis omnisque supellectilis pelliciae quomodo mundari debeat vel contaminari <chapter eID="Lev.13"/><div eID="gen107" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen108" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Lev.14" sID="Lev.14"/>

<div sID="gen109" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Lev.15" sID="Lev.15"/>

<div sID="gen110" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Lev.16" sID="Lev.16"/>

eritque hoc vobis legitimum sempiternum ut oretis pro filiis Israhel et pro cunctis peccatis eorum semel in anno fecit igitur sicut praeceperat Dominus Mosi <chapter eID="Lev.16"/><div eID="gen110" type="x-p"/>

<div sID="gen112" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Lev.18" sID="Lev.18"/>
custodite mandata mea nolite facere quae fecerunt hii qui fuerunt ante vos et ne polluamini in eis ego Dominus Deus vester <chapter eID="Lev.18"/><div eID="gen112" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen113" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Lev.19" sID="Lev.19"/>

<div sID="gen115" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Lev.21" sID="Lev.21"/>
locutus est ergo Moses ad Aaron et filios eius et ad omnem Israhel cuncta quae sibi fuerant imperata <chapter eID="Lev.21"/><div eID="gen115" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen116" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Lev.22" sID="Lev.22"/>

<div sID="gen117" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Lev.23" sID="Lev.23"/>

<div sID="gen118" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Lev.24" sID="Lev.24"/>

locutusque est Moses ad filios Israhel et eduxerunt eum qui blasphemaverat extra castra ac lapidibus oppresserunt feceruntque filii Israhel sicut praeceperat Dominus Mosi <chapter eID="Lev.24"/><div eID="gen118" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen119" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Lev.25" sID="Lev.25"/>

<div sID="gen120" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Lev.26" sID="Lev.26"/>

et recordabor foederis mei pristini quando eduxi eos de terra Aegypti in conspectu gentium ut essem Deus eorum ego Dominus Deus haec sunt praecepta atque iudicia et leges quas dedit Dominus inter se et inter filios Israhel in monte Sinai per manum Mosi <chapter eID="Lev.26"/><div eID="gen120" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen121" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Lev.27" sID="Lev.27"/>

NUM.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Num" sID="gen122" type="book"/> <milestone n="Numeri" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Numeri" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Num" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Numeri</title> <div sID="gen123" type="x-p"/>

<div sID="gen130" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Num.8" sID="Num.8"/>

eruntque ministri fratrum suorum in tabernaculo foederis ut custodiant quae sibi fuerint commendata opera autem ipsa non faciant sic dispones Levitas in custodiis suis <chapter eID="Num.8"/><div eID="gen130" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen131" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Num.9" sID="Num.9"/>
per verbum Domini figebant tentoria et per verbum illius proficiscebantur erantque in excubiis Domini iuxta imperium eius per manum Mosi <chapter eID="Num.9"/><div eID="gen131" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen132" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Num.10" sID="Num.10"/>

<div sID="gen133" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Num.11" sID="Num.11"/>

<div sID="gen134" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Num.12" sID="Num.12"/>

<div sID="gen135" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Num.13" sID="Num.13"/>

<div sID="gen136" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Num.14" sID="Num.14"/>

ego Dominus Deus vester qui eduxi vos de terra Aegypti ut essem vester Deus <chapter eID="Num.15"/><div eID="gen137" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen138" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Num.16" sID="Num.16"/>
reversusque est Aaron ad Mosen ad ostium tabernaculi foederis postquam quievit interitus <chapter eID="Num.16"/><div eID="gen138" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen139" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Num.17" sID="Num.17"/>
quicumque accedit ad tabernaculum Domini moritur num usque ad internicionem cuncti delendi sumus <chapter eID="Num.17"/><div eID="gen139" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen140" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Num.18" sID="Num.18"/>
et non peccabitis super hoc egregia vobis et pinguia reservantes ne polluatis oblationes filiorum Israhel et moriamini <chapter eID="Num.18"/><div eID="gen140" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen141" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Num.19" sID="Num.19"/>
quicquid tetigerit inmundus inmundum faciet et anima quae horum quippiam tetigerit inmunda erit usque ad vesperum <chapter eID="Num.19"/><div eID="gen141" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen142" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Num.20" sID="Num.20"/>
omnis autem multitudo videns occubuisse Aaron flevit super eo triginta diebus per cunctas familias suas <chapter eID="Num.20"/><div eID="gen142" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen143" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Num.21" sID="Num.21"/>
percusserunt igitur et hunc cum filiis suis universumque populum eius usque ad internicionem et possederunt terram illius <chapter eID="Num.21"/><div eID="gen143" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen144" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Num.22" sID="Num.22"/>
mane autem facto duxit eum ad excelsa Baal et intuitus est extremam partem populi <chapter eID="Num.22"/><div eID="gen144" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen145" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Num.23" sID="Num.23"/>
fecit Balac ut Balaam dixerat inposuitque vitulos et arietes per singulas aras <chapter eID="Num.23"/><div eID="gen145" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen146" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Num.24" sID="Num.24"/>

<div sID="gen147" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Num.25" sID="Num.25"/>

quia et ipsi hostiliter egerunt contra vos et decepere insidiis per idolum Phogor et Chozbi filiam ducis Madian sororem suam quae percussa est in die plagae pro sacrilegio Phogor <chapter eID="Num.25"/><div eID="gen147" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen148" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Num.26" sID="Num.26"/>

<div sID="gen149" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Num.27" sID="Num.27"/>
et inpositis capiti eius manibus cuncta replicavit quae mandaverat Dominus <chapter eID="Num.27"/><div eID="gen149" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen150" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Num.28" sID="Num.28"/>

haec offeretis Domino in sollemnitatibus vestris praeter vota et oblationes spontaneas in holocausto in sacrificio in libamine et in hostiis pacificis <chapter eID="Num.29"/><div eID="gen151" type="x-p"/>

<div sID="gen153" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Num.31" sID="Num.31"/>

<div sID="gen154" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Num.32" sID="Num.32"/>

<div sID="gen155" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Num.33" sID="Num.33"/>

<div sID="gen156" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Num.34" sID="Num.34"/>

<div sID="gen157" type="x-p"/><chapter n="35" osisID="Num.35" sID="Num.35"/>

absque terra filiorum Ammon ad quam non accessimus et cunctis quae adiacent torrenti Ieboc et urbibus montanis universisque locis a quibus nos prohibuit Dominus Deus noster <chapter eID="Deut.2"/><div eID="gen161" type="x-p"/>

mansimusque in valle contra fanum Phogor <chapter eID="Deut.3"/><div eID="gen162" type="x-p"/>

omnem planitiem trans Iordanem ad orientalem plagam usque ad mare Solitudinis et usque ad radices montis Phasga <chapter eID="Deut.4"/><div eID="gen163" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen164" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Deut.5" sID="Deut.5"/>

nec inferes quippiam ex idolo in domum tuam ne fias anathema sicut et illud est quasi spurcitiam detestaberis et velut inquinamentum ac sordes abominationi habebis quia anathema est <chapter eID="Deut.7"/><div eID="gen166" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen167" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Deut.8" sID="Deut.8"/>
sicut gentes quas delevit Dominus in introitu tuo ita et vos peribitis si inoboedientes fueritis voci Domini Dei vestri <chapter eID="Deut.8"/><div eID="gen167" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen168" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Deut.9" sID="Deut.9"/>
qui sunt populus tuus et hereditas tua quos eduxisti in fortitudine tua magna et in brachio tuo extento <chapter eID="Deut.9"/><div eID="gen168" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen169" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Deut.10" sID="Deut.10"/>
in septuaginta animabus descenderunt patres tui in Aegyptum et ecce nunc multiplicavit te Dominus Deus tuus sicut astra caeli <chapter eID="Deut.10"/><div eID="gen169" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen170" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Deut.11" sID="Deut.11"/>
videte ergo ut impleatis caerimonias atque iudicia quae ego hodie ponam in conspectu vestro <chapter eID="Deut.11"/><div eID="gen170" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen171" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Deut.12" sID="Deut.12"/>
quod praecipio tibi hoc tantum facito Domino nec addas quicquam nec minuas <chapter eID="Deut.12"/><div eID="gen171" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen172" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Deut.13" sID="Deut.13"/>

quando audieris vocem Domini Dei tui custodiens omnia praecepta eius quae ego praecipio tibi hodie ut facias quod placitum est in conspectu Domini Dei tui <chapter eID="Deut.13"/><div eID="gen172" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen173" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Deut.14" sID="Deut.14"/>

venietque Levites qui aliam non habet partem nec possessionem tecum et peregrinus et pupillus ac vidua qui intra portas tuas sunt et comedent et saturabuntur ut benedicat tibi Dominus Deus tuus in cunctis operibus manuum tuarum quae feceris <chapter eID="Deut.14"/><div eID="gen173" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen174" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Deut.15" sID="Deut.15"/>
hoc solum observabis ut sanguinem eorum non comedas sed effundas in terram quasi aquam <chapter eID="Deut.15"/><div eID="gen174" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen175" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Deut.16" sID="Deut.16"/>
nec facies tibi atque constitues statuam quae odit Dominus Deus tuus <chapter eID="Deut.16"/><div eID="gen175" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen176" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Deut.17" sID="Deut.17"/>

nec elevetur cor eius in superbiam super fratres suos neque declinet in partem dextram vel sinistram ut longo tempore regnet ipse et filii eius super Israhel <chapter eID="Deut.17"/><div eID="gen176" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen177" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Deut.18" sID="Deut.18"/>

hoc habebis signum quod in nomine Domini propheta ille praedixerit et non evenerit hoc Dominus non locutus est sed per tumorem animi sui propheta confinxit et idcirco non timebis eum <chapter eID="Deut.18"/><div eID="gen177" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen178" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Deut.19" sID="Deut.19"/>
non misereberis eius sed animam pro anima oculum pro oculo dentem pro dente manum pro manu pedem pro pede exiges <chapter eID="Deut.19"/><div eID="gen178" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen179" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Deut.20" sID="Deut.20"/>

si qua autem ligna non sunt pomifera sed agrestia et in ceteros apta usus succide et extrue machinas donec capias civitatem quae contra te dimicat <chapter eID="Deut.20"/><div eID="gen179" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen180" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Deut.21" sID="Deut.21"/>

non permanebit cadaver eius in ligno sed in eadem die sepelietur quia maledictus a Deo est qui pendet in ligno et nequaquam contaminabis terram tuam quam Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi in possessionem <chapter eID="Deut.21"/><div eID="gen180" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen181" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Deut.22" sID="Deut.22"/>
non accipiet homo uxorem patris sui nec revelabit operimentum eius <chapter eID="Deut.22"/><div eID="gen181" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen182" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Deut.23" sID="Deut.23"/>
si intraveris in segetem amici tui franges spicas et manu conteres falce autem non metes <chapter eID="Deut.23"/><div eID="gen182" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen183" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Deut.24" sID="Deut.24"/>
memento quod et tu servieris in Aegypto et idcirco praecipiam tibi ut facias hanc rem <chapter eID="Deut.24"/><div eID="gen183" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen184" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Deut.25" sID="Deut.25"/>

cum ergo Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi requiem et subiecerit cunctas per circuitum nationes in terra quam tibi pollicitus est delebis nomen eius sub caelo cave ne obliviscaris <chapter eID="Deut.25"/><div eID="gen184" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen185" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Deut.26" sID="Deut.26"/>

et faciat te excelsiorem cunctis gentibus quas creavit in laudem et nomen et gloriam suam ut sis populus sanctus Domini Dei tui sicut locutus est <chapter eID="Deut.26"/><div eID="gen185" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen186" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Deut.27" sID="Deut.27"/>
maledictus qui non permanet in sermonibus legis huius nec eos opere perficit et dicet omnis populus amen <chapter eID="Deut.27"/><div eID="gen186" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen187" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Deut.28" sID="Deut.28"/>

reducet te Dominus classibus in Aegyptum per viam de qua dixi tibi ut eam amplius non videres ibi venderis inimicis tuis in servos et ancillas et non erit qui emat <chapter eID="Deut.28"/><div eID="gen187" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen188" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="Deut.29" sID="Deut.29"/>
abscondita Domino Deo nostro quae manifesta sunt nobis et filiis nostris usque in aeternum ut faciamus universa legis huius <chapter eID="Deut.29"/><div eID="gen188" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen189" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="Deut.30" sID="Deut.30"/>

et diligas Dominum Deum tuum atque oboedias voci eius et illi adhereas ipse est enim vita tua et longitudo dierum tuorum ut habites in terra pro qua iuravit Dominus patribus tuis Abraham Isaac et Iacob ut daret eam illis <chapter eID="Deut.30"/><div eID="gen189" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen190" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Deut.31" sID="Deut.31"/>
locutus est ergo Moses audiente universo coetu Israhel verba carminis huius et ad finem usque conplevit <chapter eID="Deut.31"/><div eID="gen190" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen191" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Deut.32" sID="Deut.32"/>
e contra videbis terram et non ingredieris in eam quam ego dabo filiis Israhel <chapter eID="Deut.32"/><div eID="gen191" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen192" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Deut.33" sID="Deut.33"/>

beatus tu Israhel quis similis tui popule qui salvaris in Domino scutum auxilii tui et gladius gloriae tuae negabunt te inimici tui et tu eorum colla calcabis <chapter eID="Deut.33"/><div eID="gen192" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen193" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Deut.34" sID="Deut.34"/>

et cunctam manum robustam magnaque mirabilia quae fecit Moses coram universo Israhel <chapter eID="Deut.34"/><div eID="gen193" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen159" osisID="Deut" type="book"/>

JOS.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Josh" sID="gen194" type="book"/> <milestone n="Iosue" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Iosue" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Ios" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Iosue</title> <div sID="gen195" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Josh.1" sID="Josh.1"/>
qui contradixerit ori tuo et non oboedierit cunctis sermonibus quos praeceperis ei moriatur tu tantum confortare et viriliter age <chapter eID="Josh.1"/><div eID="gen195" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen196" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Josh.2" sID="Josh.2"/>
atque dixerunt tradidit Dominus in manus nostras omnem terram hanc et timore prostrati sunt cuncti habitatores eius <chapter eID="Josh.2"/><div eID="gen196" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen197" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Josh.3" sID="Josh.3"/>

populus autem incedebat contra Iordanem et sacerdotes qui portabant arcam foederis Domini stabant super siccam humum in medio Iordanis accincti omnisque populus per arentem alveum transiebat <chapter eID="Josh.3"/><div eID="gen197" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen198" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Josh.4" sID="Josh.4"/>
ut discant omnes terrarum populi fortissimam Domini manum et ut vos timeatis Dominum Deum vestrum omni tempore <chapter eID="Josh.4"/><div eID="gen198" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen199" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Josh.5" sID="Josh.5"/>
solve inquit calciamentum de pedibus tuis locus enim in quo stas sanctus est fecitque Iosue ut sibi fuerat imperatum <chapter eID="Josh.5"/><div eID="gen199" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen200" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Josh.6" sID="Josh.6"/>
fuit ergo Dominus cum Iosue et nomen eius in omni terra vulgatum est <chapter eID="Josh.6"/><div eID="gen200" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen201" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Josh.7" sID="Josh.7"/>

congregaverunt quoque super eum acervum magnum lapidum qui permanet usque in praesentem diem et aversus est furor Domini ab eis vocatumque est nomen loci illius vallis Achor usque hodie <chapter eID="Josh.7"/><div eID="gen201" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen202" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Josh.8" sID="Josh.8"/>

nihil ex his quae Moses iusserat reliquit intactum sed universa replicavit coram omni multitudine Israhel mulieribus ac parvulis et advenis qui inter eos morabantur <chapter eID="Josh.8"/><div eID="gen202" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen203" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Josh.9" sID="Josh.9"/>

decrevitque in illo die esse eos in ministerium cuncti populi et altaris Domini caedentes ligna et aquas conportantes usque in praesens tempus in loco quem Dominus elegisset <chapter eID="Josh.9"/><div eID="gen203" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen204" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Josh.10" sID="Josh.10"/>

universos reges et regiones eorum uno cepit impetu atque vastavit Dominus enim Deus Israhel pugnabat pro eo reversusque est cum omni Israhele ad locum castrorum in Galgala <chapter eID="Josh.10"/><div eID="gen204" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen205" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Josh.11" sID="Josh.11"/>

cepit ergo Iosue omnem terram sicut locutus est Dominus ad Mosen et tradidit eam in possessionem filiis Israhel secundum partes et tribus suas quievitque terra a proeliis <chapter eID="Josh.11"/><div eID="gen205" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen206" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Josh.12" sID="Josh.12"/>
rex Thersa unus omnes reges triginta et unus <chapter eID="Josh.12"/><div eID="gen206" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen207" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Josh.13" sID="Josh.13"/>
tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem quoniam Dominus Deus Israhel ipse est possessio eius ut locutus est illi <chapter eID="Josh.13"/><div eID="gen207" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen208" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Josh.14" sID="Josh.14"/>
nomen Hebron antea vocabatur Cariatharbe Adam maximus ibi inter Enacim situs est et terra cessavit a proeliis <chapter eID="Josh.14"/><div eID="gen208" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen209" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Josh.15" sID="Josh.15"/>

Iebuseum autem habitatorem Hierusalem non potuerunt filii Iuda delere habitavitque Iebuseus cum filiis Iuda in Hierusalem usque in praesentem diem <chapter eID="Josh.15"/><div eID="gen209" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen210" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Josh.16" sID="Josh.16"/>
et non interfecerunt filii Ephraim Chananeum qui habitabat in Gazer habitavitque Chananeus in medio Ephraim usque in diem hanc tributarius <chapter eID="Josh.16"/><div eID="gen210" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen211" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Josh.17" sID="Josh.17"/>

sed transibis ad montem et succides tibi atque purgabis ad habitandum spatia et poteris ultra procedere cum subverteris Chananeum quem dicis ferreos habere currus et esse fortissimum <chapter eID="Josh.17"/><div eID="gen211" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen212" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Josh.18" sID="Josh.18"/>

et Sela Eleph et Iebus quae est Hierusalem Gabaath et Cariath civitates quattuordecim et villae earum haec est possessio filiorum Beniamin iuxta familias suas <chapter eID="Josh.18"/><div eID="gen212" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen213" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Josh.19" sID="Josh.19"/>

hae sunt possessiones quas sorte diviserunt Eleazar sacerdos et Iosue filius Nun et principes familiarum ac tribuum filiorum Israhel in Silo coram Domino ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii partitique sunt terram <chapter eID="Josh.19"/><div eID="gen213" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen214" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Josh.20" sID="Josh.20"/>

hae civitates constitutae sunt cunctis filiis Israhel et advenis qui habitant inter eos ut fugeret ad eas qui animam nescius percussisset et non moreretur in manu proximi effusum sanguinem vindicare cupientis donec staret ante populum expositurus causam suam <chapter eID="Josh.20"/><div eID="gen214" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen215" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Josh.21" sID="Josh.21"/>
ne unum quidem verbum quod illis praestaturum se esse promiserat irritum fuit sed rebus expleta sunt omnia <chapter eID="Josh.21"/><div eID="gen215" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen216" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Josh.22" sID="Josh.22"/>
vocaveruntque filii Ruben et filii Gad altare quod extruxerant Testimonium nostrum quod Dominus ipse sit Deus <chapter eID="Josh.22"/><div eID="gen216" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen217" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Josh.23" sID="Josh.23"/>

eo quod praeterieritis pactum Domini Dei vestri quod pepigit vobiscum et servieritis diis alienis et adoraveritis eos cito atque velociter consurget in vos furor Domini et auferemini de terra hac optima quam tradidit vobis <chapter eID="Josh.23"/><div eID="gen217" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen218" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Josh.24" sID="Josh.24"/>

Eleazar quoque filius Aaron mortuus est et sepelierunt eum in Gaab Finees filii eius quae data est ei in monte Ephraim <chapter eID="Josh.24"/><div eID="gen218" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen194" osisID="Josh" type="book"/>

JDG.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Judg" sID="gen219" type="book"/> <milestone n="Iudicum" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Iudicum" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Iud" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Iudicum</title> <div sID="gen220" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Judg.1" sID="Judg.1"/>
fuit autem terminus Amorrei ab ascensu Scorpionis Petra et superiora loca <chapter eID="Judg.1"/><div eID="gen220" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen221" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Judg.2" sID="Judg.2"/>
dimisit ergo Dominus omnes has nationes et cito subvertere noluit nec tradidit in manibus Iosue <chapter eID="Judg.2"/><div eID="gen221" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen222" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Judg.3" sID="Judg.3"/>
post hunc fuit Samgar filius Anath qui percussit de Philisthim sescentos viros vomere et ipse quoque defendit Israhel <chapter eID="Judg.3"/><div eID="gen222" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen223" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Judg.4" sID="Judg.4"/>
qui crescebant cotidie et forti manu opprimebant Iabin regem Chanaan donec delerent eum <chapter eID="Judg.4"/><div eID="gen223" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen224" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Judg.5" sID="Judg.5"/>
quievitque terra per quadraginta annos <chapter eID="Judg.5"/><div eID="gen224" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen225" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Judg.6" sID="Judg.6"/>
fecitque Dominus nocte illa ut postulaverat et fuit siccitas in solo vellere et ros in omni terra <chapter eID="Judg.6"/><div eID="gen225" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen226" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Judg.7" sID="Judg.7"/>

adprehensosque duos viros Madian Oreb et Zeb interfecit Oreb in petra Oreb Zeb vero in torculari Zeb et persecuti sunt Madian capita Oreb et Zeb portantes ad Gedeon trans fluenta Iordanis <chapter eID="Judg.7"/><div eID="gen226" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen227" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Judg.8" sID="Judg.8"/>
nec fecerunt misericordiam cum domo Hierobbaal Gedeon iuxta omnia bona quae fecerat Israheli <chapter eID="Judg.8"/><div eID="gen227" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen228" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Judg.9" sID="Judg.9"/>
Sycimitis quoque quod operati erant retributum est et venit super eos maledictio Ioatham filii Hierobbaal <chapter eID="Judg.9"/><div eID="gen228" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen229" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Judg.10" sID="Judg.10"/>
dixeruntque principes Galaad singuli ad proximos suos qui primus e nobis contra filios Ammon coeperit dimicare erit dux populi Galaad <chapter eID="Judg.10"/><div eID="gen229" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen230" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Judg.11" sID="Judg.11"/>
ut post anni circulum conveniant in unum filiae Israhel et plangant filiam Iepthae Galaaditae diebus quattuor <chapter eID="Judg.11"/><div eID="gen230" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen231" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Judg.12" sID="Judg.12"/>
mortuusque est ac sepultus in Farathon terrae Ephraim in monte Amalech <chapter eID="Judg.12"/><div eID="gen231" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen232" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Judg.13" sID="Judg.13"/>
coepitque spiritus Domini esse cum eo in castris Dan inter Saraa et Esthaol <chapter eID="Judg.13"/><div eID="gen232" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen233" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Judg.14" sID="Judg.14"/>
uxor autem eius accepit maritum unum de amicis eius et pronubis <chapter eID="Judg.14"/><div eID="gen233" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen234" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Judg.15" sID="Judg.15"/>
iudicavitque Israhel in diebus Philisthim viginti annis <chapter eID="Judg.15"/><div eID="gen234" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen235" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Judg.16" sID="Judg.16"/>

descendentes autem fratres eius et universa cognatio tulerunt corpus eius et sepelierunt inter Saraa et Esthaol in sepulchro patris Manue iudicavitque Israhel viginti annis <chapter eID="Judg.16"/><div eID="gen235" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen236" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Judg.17" sID="Judg.17"/>
nunc scio dicens quod bene mihi faciat Deus habenti levitici generis sacerdotem <chapter eID="Judg.17"/><div eID="gen236" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen237" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Judg.18" sID="Judg.18"/>
mansitque apud eos idolum Michae omni tempore quo fuit domus Dei in Silo in diebus illis non erat rex in Israhel <chapter eID="Judg.18"/><div eID="gen237" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen238" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Judg.19" sID="Judg.19"/>

quod cum vidissent singuli conclamabant numquam res talis facta est in Israhel ex eo die quo ascenderunt patres nostri de Aegypto usque in praesens tempus ferte sententiam et in commune decernite quid facto opus sit <chapter eID="Judg.19"/><div eID="gen238" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen239" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Judg.20" sID="Judg.20"/>

regressi autem filii Israhel omnes reliquias civitatis a viris usque ad iumenta gladio percusserunt cunctasque urbes et viculos Beniamin vorax flamma consumpsit <chapter eID="Judg.20"/><div eID="gen239" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen240" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Judg.21" sID="Judg.21"/>

filii quoque Israhel reversi sunt per tribus et familias in tabernacula sua in diebus illis non erat rex in Israhel sed unusquisque quod sibi rectum videbatur hoc faciebat <chapter eID="Judg.21"/><div eID="gen240" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen219" osisID="Judg" type="book"/>

RUT.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Ruth" sID="gen241" type="book"/> <milestone n="Ruth" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Ruth" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Ruth" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Ruth</title> <div sID="gen242" type="x-p"/>
venit ergo Noemi cum Ruth Moabitide nuru sua de terra peregrinationis suae ac reversa est in Bethleem quando primum hordea metebantur <chapter eID="Ruth.1"/><div eID="gen242" type="x-p"/>
iuncta est itaque puellis Booz et tamdiu cum eis messuit donec hordea et triticum in horreis conderentur <chapter eID="Ruth.2"/><div eID="gen243" type="x-p"/>
dixitque Noemi expecta filia donec videamus quem res exitum habeat neque enim cessabit homo nisi conpleverit quod locutus est <chapter eID="Ruth.3"/><div eID="gen244" type="x-p"/>
Obed genuit Isai Isai genuit David <chapter eID="Ruth.4"/><div eID="gen245" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen241" osisID="Ruth" type="book"/>

1SA.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="1Sam" sID="gen246" type="book"/> <milestone n="I Samuelis" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="I Samuelis" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="I Sam" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">I Samuelis</title> <div sID="gen247" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="1Sam.1" sID="1Sam.1"/>
idcirco et ego commodavi eum Domino cunctis diebus quibus fuerit accommodatus Domino et adoraverunt ibi Dominum et oravit Anna et ait <chapter eID="1Sam.1"/><div eID="gen247" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen248" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="1Sam.2" sID="1Sam.2"/>

futurum est autem ut quicumque remanserit in domo tua veniat ut oretur pro eo et offerat nummum argenteum et tortam panis dicatque dimitte me obsecro ad unam partem sacerdotalem ut comedam buccellam panis <chapter eID="1Sam.2"/><div eID="gen248" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen249" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="1Sam.3" sID="1Sam.3"/>

et addidit Dominus ut appareret in Silo quoniam revelatus fuerat Dominus Samuheli in Silo iuxta verbum Domini et evenit sermo Samuhelis universo Israheli <chapter eID="1Sam.3"/><div eID="gen249" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen250" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="1Sam.4" sID="1Sam.4"/>
et ait translata est gloria ab Israhel eo quod capta esset arca Dei <chapter eID="1Sam.4"/><div eID="gen250" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen251" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="1Sam.5" sID="1Sam.5"/>

fiebat enim pavor mortis in singulis urbibus et gravissima valde manus Dei viri quoque qui mortui non fuerant percutiebantur in secretiori parte natium et ascendebat ululatus uniuscuiusque civitatis in caelum <chapter eID="1Sam.5"/><div eID="gen251" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen252" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="1Sam.6" sID="1Sam.6"/>
miseruntque nuntios ad habitatores Cariathiarim dicentes reduxerunt Philisthim arcam Domini descendite et ducite eam ad vos <chapter eID="1Sam.6"/><div eID="gen252" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen253" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="1Sam.7" sID="1Sam.7"/>
revertebaturque in Ramatha ibi enim erat domus eius et ibi iudicabat Israhelem aedificavit etiam ibi altare Domino <chapter eID="1Sam.7"/><div eID="gen253" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen254" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="1Sam.8" sID="1Sam.8"/>
dixit autem Dominus ad Samuhel audi vocem eorum et constitue super eos regem et ait Samuhel ad viros Israhel vadat unusquisque in civitatem suam <chapter eID="1Sam.8"/><div eID="gen254" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen255" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="1Sam.9" sID="1Sam.9"/>

cumque descenderent in extrema parte civitatis Samuhel dixit ad Saul dic puero ut antecedat nos et transeat tu autem subsiste paulisper ut indicem tibi verbum Domini <chapter eID="1Sam.9"/><div eID="gen255" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen256" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="1Sam.10" sID="1Sam.10"/>
filii vero Belial dixerunt num salvare nos poterit iste et despexerunt eum et non adtulerunt ei munera ille vero dissimulabat se audire <chapter eID="1Sam.10"/><div eID="gen256" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen257" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="1Sam.11" sID="1Sam.11"/>

et perrexit omnis populus in Galgala et fecerunt ibi regem Saul coram Domino in Galgala et immolaverunt ibi victimas pacificas coram Domino et laetatus est ibi Saul et cuncti viri Israhel nimis <chapter eID="1Sam.11"/><div eID="gen257" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen258" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="1Sam.12" sID="1Sam.12"/>
quod si perseveraveritis in malitia et vos et rex vester pariter peribitis <chapter eID="1Sam.12"/><div eID="gen258" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen259" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="1Sam.13" sID="1Sam.13"/>
egressa est autem statio Philisthim ut transcenderet in Machmas <chapter eID="1Sam.13"/><div eID="gen259" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen260" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="1Sam.14" sID="1Sam.14"/>

erat autem bellum potens adversum Philistheos omnibus diebus Saul nam quemcumque viderat Saul virum fortem et aptum ad proelium sociabat eum sibi <chapter eID="1Sam.14"/><div eID="gen260" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen261" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="1Sam.15" sID="1Sam.15"/>

et non vidit Samuhel ultra Saul usque ad diem mortis suae verumtamen lugebat Samuhel Saul quoniam Dominum paenitebat quod constituisset regem Saul super Israhel <chapter eID="1Sam.15"/><div eID="gen261" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen262" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="1Sam.16" sID="1Sam.16"/>

igitur quandocumque spiritus Dei arripiebat Saul tollebat David citharam et percutiebat manu sua et refocilabatur Saul et levius habebat recedebat enim ab eo spiritus malus <chapter eID="1Sam.16"/><div eID="gen262" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen263" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="1Sam.17" sID="1Sam.17"/>
et ait ad eum Saul de qua progenie es o adulescens dixitque David filius servi tui Isai Bethleemitae ego sum <chapter eID="1Sam.17"/><div eID="gen263" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen264" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="1Sam.18" sID="1Sam.18"/>

et egressi sunt principes Philisthinorum a principio autem egressionis eorum prudentius se gerebat David quam omnes servi Saul et celebre factum est nomen eius nimis <chapter eID="1Sam.18"/><div eID="gen264" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen265" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="1Sam.19" sID="1Sam.19"/>

et expoliavit se etiam ipse vestimentis suis et prophetavit cum ceteris coram Samuhel et cecidit nudus tota die illa et nocte unde et exivit proverbium num et Saul inter prophetas <chapter eID="1Sam.19"/><div eID="gen265" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen266" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="1Sam.20" sID="1Sam.20"/>
et surrexit et abiit sed et Ionathan ingressus est civitatem <chapter eID="1Sam.20"/><div eID="gen266" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen267" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="1Sam.21" sID="1Sam.21"/>
an desunt nobis furiosi quod introduxistis istum ut fureret me praesente hicine ingredietur domum meam <chapter eID="1Sam.21"/><div eID="gen267" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen268" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="1Sam.22" sID="1Sam.22"/>
mane mecum ne timeas si quis quaesierit animam meam quaeret et animam tuam mecumque servaberis <chapter eID="1Sam.22"/><div eID="gen268" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen269" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="1Sam.23" sID="1Sam.23"/>
reversus est ergo Saul desistens persequi David et perrexit in occursum Philisthinorum propter hoc vocaverunt locum illum petram Dividentem <chapter eID="1Sam.23"/><div eID="gen269" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen270" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="1Sam.24" sID="1Sam.24"/>
et iuravit David Sauli abiit ergo Saul in domum suam et David et viri eius ascenderunt ad tutiora loca <chapter eID="1Sam.24"/><div eID="gen270" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen271" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="1Sam.25" sID="1Sam.25"/>
Saul autem dedit Michol filiam suam uxorem David Falti filio Lais qui erat de Gallim <chapter eID="1Sam.25"/><div eID="gen271" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen272" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="1Sam.26" sID="1Sam.26"/>

ait ergo Saul ad David benedictus tu fili mi David et quidem faciens facies et potens poteris abiit autem David in viam suam et Saul reversus est in locum suum <chapter eID="1Sam.26"/><div eID="gen272" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen273" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="1Sam.27" sID="1Sam.27"/>
credidit ergo Achis David dicens multa mala operatus est contra populum suum Israhel erit igitur mihi servus sempiternus <chapter eID="1Sam.27"/><div eID="gen273" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen274" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="1Sam.28" sID="1Sam.28"/>
et posuit ante Saul et ante servos eius qui cum comedissent surrexerunt et ambulaverunt per totam noctem illam <chapter eID="1Sam.28"/><div eID="gen274" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen275" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="1Sam.29" sID="1Sam.29"/>

surrexit itaque de nocte David ipse et viri eius ut proficiscerentur mane et reverterentur ad terram Philisthim Philisthim autem ascenderunt in Iezrahel <chapter eID="1Sam.29"/><div eID="gen275" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen276" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="1Sam.30" sID="1Sam.30"/>
et qui in Hebron et reliquis qui erant in his locis in quibus commoratus fuerat David ipse et viri eius <chapter eID="1Sam.30"/><div eID="gen276" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen277" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="1Sam.31" sID="1Sam.31"/>

et tulerunt ossa eorum et sepelierunt in nemore Iabes et ieiunaverunt septem diebus <chapter eID="1Sam.31"/><div eID="gen277" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen246" osisID="1Sam" type="book"/>

2SA.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="2Sam" sID="gen278" type="book"/> <milestone n="II Samuelis" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="II Samuelis" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="II Sam" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">II Samuelis</title> <div sID="gen279" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="2Sam.1" sID="2Sam.1"/>
quomodo ceciderunt robusti et perierunt arma bellica <chapter eID="2Sam.1"/><div eID="gen279" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen280" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="2Sam.2" sID="2Sam.2"/>

tuleruntque Asahel et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro patris sui in Bethleem et ambulaverunt tota nocte Ioab et viri qui erant cum eo et in ipso crepusculo pervenerunt in Hebron <chapter eID="2Sam.2"/><div eID="gen280" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen281" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="2Sam.3" sID="2Sam.3"/>
ego autem adhuc delicatus et unctus rex porro viri isti filii Sarviae duri mihi sunt retribuat Dominus facienti malum iuxta malitiam suam <chapter eID="2Sam.3"/><div eID="gen281" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen282" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="2Sam.4" sID="2Sam.4"/>

praecepit itaque David pueris et interfecerunt eos praecidentesque manus et pedes eorum suspenderunt eos super piscinam in Hebron caput autem Hisboseth tulerunt et sepelierunt in sepulchro Abner in Hebron <chapter eID="2Sam.4"/><div eID="gen282" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen283" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="2Sam.5" sID="2Sam.5"/>
fecit itaque David sicut ei praeceperat Dominus et percussit Philisthim de Gabee usque dum venias Gezer <chapter eID="2Sam.5"/><div eID="gen283" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen284" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="2Sam.6" sID="2Sam.6"/>
igitur Michol filiae Saul non est natus filius usque ad diem mortis suae <chapter eID="2Sam.6"/><div eID="gen284" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen285" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="2Sam.7" sID="2Sam.7"/>

incipe igitur et benedic domui servi tui ut sit in sempiternum coram te quia tu Domine Deus locutus es et benedictione tua benedicetur domus servi tui in sempiternum <chapter eID="2Sam.7"/><div eID="gen285" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen286" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="2Sam.8" sID="2Sam.8"/>
Banaias autem filius Ioiada super Cherethi et Felethi filii autem David sacerdotes erant <chapter eID="2Sam.8"/><div eID="gen286" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen287" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="2Sam.9" sID="2Sam.9"/>
porro Mifiboseth habitabat in Hierusalem quia de mensa regis iugiter vescebatur et erat claudus utroque pede <chapter eID="2Sam.9"/><div eID="gen287" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen288" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="2Sam.10" sID="2Sam.10"/>

videntes autem universi reges qui erant in praesidio Adadezer victos se ab Israhel fecerunt pacem cum Israhel et servierunt eis timueruntque Syri auxilium praebere filiis Ammon <chapter eID="2Sam.10"/><div eID="gen288" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen289" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="2Sam.11" sID="2Sam.11"/>

transactoque luctu misit David et introduxit eam domum suam et facta est ei uxor peperitque ei filium et displicuit verbum hoc quod fecerat David coram Domino <chapter eID="2Sam.11"/><div eID="gen289" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen290" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="2Sam.12" sID="2Sam.12"/>

populum quoque eius adducens serravit et circumegit super eos ferrata carpenta divisitque cultris et transduxit in typo laterum sic fecit universis civitatibus filiorum Ammon et reversus est David et omnis exercitus Hierusalem <chapter eID="2Sam.12"/><div eID="gen290" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen291" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="2Sam.13" sID="2Sam.13"/>
cessavitque David rex persequi Absalom eo quod consolatus esset super Amnon interitu <chapter eID="2Sam.13"/><div eID="gen291" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen292" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="2Sam.14" sID="2Sam.14"/>
ingressus Ioab ad regem nuntiavit ei vocatusque Absalom intravit ad regem et adoravit super faciem terrae coram eo osculatusque est rex Absalom <chapter eID="2Sam.14"/><div eID="gen292" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen293" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="2Sam.15" sID="2Sam.15"/>
veniente ergo Husai amico David in civitatem Absalom quoque ingressus est Hierusalem <chapter eID="2Sam.15"/><div eID="gen293" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen294" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="2Sam.16" sID="2Sam.16"/>

consilium autem Ahitofel quod dabat in diebus illis quasi si quis consuleret Deum sic erat omne consilium Ahitofel et cum esset cum David et cum esset cum Absalom <chapter eID="2Sam.16"/><div eID="gen294" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen295" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="2Sam.17" sID="2Sam.17"/>

et mel et butyrum oves et pingues vitulos dederuntque David et populo qui cum eo erat ad vescendum suspicati enim sunt populum fame et siti fatigari in deserto <chapter eID="2Sam.17"/><div eID="gen295" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen296" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="2Sam.18" sID="2Sam.18"/>

contristatus itaque rex ascendit cenaculum portae et flevit et sic loquebatur vadens fili mi Absalom fili mi Absalom quis mihi tribuat ut ego moriar pro te Absalom fili mi fili mi <chapter eID="2Sam.18"/><div eID="gen296" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen297" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="2Sam.19" sID="2Sam.19"/>

et respondit vir Israhel ad viros Iuda et ait decem partibus maior ego sum apud regem magisque ad me pertinet David quam ad te cur mihi fecisti iniuriam et non mihi nuntiatum est priori ut reducerem regem meum durius autem responderunt viri Iuda viris Israhel <chapter eID="2Sam.19"/><div eID="gen297" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen298" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="2Sam.20" sID="2Sam.20"/>
Hira autem Hiaiarites erat sacerdos David <chapter eID="2Sam.20"/><div eID="gen298" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen299" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="2Sam.21" sID="2Sam.21"/>
hii quattuor nati sunt de Arafa in Geth et ceciderunt in manu David et servorum eius <chapter eID="2Sam.21"/><div eID="gen299" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen300" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="2Sam.22" sID="2Sam.22"/>
magnificanti salutes regis sui et facienti misericordiam christo suo David et semini eius in sempiternum <chapter eID="2Sam.22"/><div eID="gen300" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen301" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="2Sam.23" sID="2Sam.23"/>
Urias Hettheus omnes triginta septem <chapter eID="2Sam.23"/><div eID="gen301" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen302" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="2Sam.24" sID="2Sam.24"/>

et aedificavit ibi David altare Domino et obtulit holocausta et pacifica et repropitiatus est Dominus terrae et cohibita est plaga ab Israhel <chapter eID="2Sam.24"/><div eID="gen302" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen278" osisID="2Sam" type="book"/>

1KI.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="1Kgs" sID="gen303" type="book"/> <milestone n="I Regum" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="I Regum" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="I Reg" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">I Regum</title> <div sID="gen304" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="1Kgs.1" sID="1Kgs.1"/>
misit ergo rex Salomon et eduxit eum ab altari et ingressus adoravit regem Salomonem dixitque ei Salomon vade in domum tuam <chapter eID="1Kgs.1"/><div eID="gen304" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen305" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="1Kgs.2" sID="1Kgs.2"/>
iussit itaque rex Banaiae filio Ioiadae qui egressus percussit eum et mortuus est <chapter eID="1Kgs.2"/><div eID="gen305" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen306" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="1Kgs.3" sID="1Kgs.3"/>
audivit itaque omnis Israhel iudicium quod iudicasset rex et timuerunt regem videntes sapientiam Dei esse in eo ad faciendum iudicium <chapter eID="1Kgs.3"/><div eID="gen306" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen307" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="1Kgs.4" sID="1Kgs.4"/>
et veniebant de cunctis populis ad audiendam sapientiam Salomonis et ab universis regibus terrae qui audiebant sapientiam eius <chapter eID="1Kgs.4"/><div eID="gen307" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen308" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="1Kgs.5" sID="1Kgs.5"/>
quos dolaverunt cementarii Salomonis et cementarii Hiram porro Biblii praeparaverunt ligna et lapides ad aedificandam domum <chapter eID="1Kgs.5"/><div eID="gen308" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen309" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="1Kgs.6" sID="1Kgs.6"/>

et in anno undecimo mense bul ipse est mensis octavus perfecta est domus in omni opere suo et in universis utensilibus aedificavitque eam annis septem <chapter eID="1Kgs.6"/><div eID="gen309" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen310" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="1Kgs.7" sID="1Kgs.7"/>

et perfecit omne opus quod faciebat Salomon in domo Domini et intulit quae sanctificaverat David pater suus argentum et aurum et vasa reposuitque in thesauris domus Domini <chapter eID="1Kgs.7"/><div eID="gen310" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen311" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="1Kgs.8" sID="1Kgs.8"/>

et in die octava dimisit populos qui benedicentes regi profecti sunt in tabernacula sua laetantes et alacri corde super omnibus bonis quae fecerat Dominus David servo suo et Israhel populo suo <chapter eID="1Kgs.8"/><div eID="gen311" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen312" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="1Kgs.9" sID="1Kgs.9"/>
qui cum venissent in Ophir sumptum inde aurum quadringentorum viginti talentorum detulerunt ad regem Salomonem <chapter eID="1Kgs.9"/><div eID="gen312" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen313" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="1Kgs.10" sID="1Kgs.10"/>

egrediebatur autem quadriga ex Aegypto sescentis siclis argenti et equus centum quinquaginta atque in hunc modum cuncti reges Hettheorum et Syriae equos venundabant <chapter eID="1Kgs.10"/><div eID="gen313" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen314" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="1Kgs.11" sID="1Kgs.11"/>
dormivitque Salomon cum patribus suis et sepultus est in civitate David patris sui regnavitque Roboam filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="1Kgs.11"/><div eID="gen314" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen315" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="1Kgs.12" sID="1Kgs.12"/>

et ascendit super altare quod extruxerat in Bethel quintadecima die mensis octavi quem finxerat de corde suo et fecit sollemnitatem filiis Israhel et ascendit super altare ut adoleret incensum <chapter eID="1Kgs.12"/><div eID="gen315" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen316" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="1Kgs.13" sID="1Kgs.13"/>
et propter hanc causam peccavit domus Hieroboam et eversa est et deleta de superficie terrae <chapter eID="1Kgs.13"/><div eID="gen316" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen317" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="1Kgs.14" sID="1Kgs.14"/>

dormivit itaque Roboam cum patribus suis et sepultus est cum eis in civitate David nomen autem matris eius Naama Ammanites et regnavit Abiam filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="1Kgs.14"/><div eID="gen317" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen318" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="1Kgs.15" sID="1Kgs.15"/>
et fecit malum coram Domino ambulavitque in via Hieroboam et in peccatis eius quibus peccare fecit Israhel <chapter eID="1Kgs.15"/><div eID="gen318" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen319" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="1Kgs.16" sID="1Kgs.16"/>

in diebus eius aedificavit Ahiel de Bethel Hiericho in Abiram primitivo suo fundavit eam et in Segub novissimo suo posuit portas eius iuxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat in manu Iosue filii Nun <chapter eID="1Kgs.16"/><div eID="gen319" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen320" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="1Kgs.17" sID="1Kgs.17"/>
dixitque mulier ad Heliam nunc in isto cognovi quoniam vir Dei es tu et verbum Domini in ore tuo verum est <chapter eID="1Kgs.17"/><div eID="gen320" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen321" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="1Kgs.18" sID="1Kgs.18"/>
et manus Domini facta est super Heliam accinctisque lumbis currebat ante Ahab donec veniret in Hiezrahel <chapter eID="1Kgs.18"/><div eID="gen321" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen322" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="1Kgs.19" sID="1Kgs.19"/>

reversus autem ab eo tulit par boum et mactavit illud et in aratro boum coxit carnes et dedit populo et comederunt consurgensque abiit et secutus est Heliam et ministrabat ei <chapter eID="1Kgs.19"/><div eID="gen322" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen323" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="1Kgs.20" sID="1Kgs.20"/>
reversus est igitur rex Israhel in domum suam audire contemnens et furibundus venit Samariam <chapter eID="1Kgs.20"/><div eID="gen323" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen324" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="1Kgs.21" sID="1Kgs.21"/>

nonne vidisti humiliatum Ahab coram me quia igitur humiliatus est mei causa non inducam malum in diebus eius sed in diebus filii sui inferam malum domui eius <chapter eID="1Kgs.21"/><div eID="gen324" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen325" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="1Kgs.22" sID="1Kgs.22"/>

servivit quoque Baal et adoravit eum et inritavit Dominum Deum Israhel iuxta omnia quae fecerat pater eius <chapter eID="1Kgs.22"/><div eID="gen325" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen303" osisID="1Kgs" type="book"/>

2KI.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="2Kgs" sID="gen326" type="book"/> <milestone n="Regum II" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Regum II" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="II Reg" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Regum II</title> <div sID="gen327" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="2Kgs.1" sID="2Kgs.1"/>
reliqua autem verborum Ohoziae quae operatus est nonne haec scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israhel <chapter eID="2Kgs.1"/><div eID="gen327" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen328" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="2Kgs.2" sID="2Kgs.2"/>
abiit autem inde in montem Carmeli et inde reversus est Samariam <chapter eID="2Kgs.2"/><div eID="gen328" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen329" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="2Kgs.3" sID="2Kgs.3"/>

arripiensque filium suum primogenitum qui regnaturus erat pro eo obtulit holocaustum super murum et facta est indignatio magna in Israhel statimque recesserunt ab eo et reversi sunt in terram suam <chapter eID="2Kgs.3"/><div eID="gen329" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen330" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="2Kgs.4" sID="2Kgs.4"/>
posuit itaque coram eis qui comederunt et superfuit iuxta verbum Domini <chapter eID="2Kgs.4"/><div eID="gen330" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen331" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="2Kgs.5" sID="2Kgs.5"/>
sed et lepra Naaman adherebit tibi et semini tuo in sempiternum et egressus est ab eo leprosus quasi nix <chapter eID="2Kgs.5"/><div eID="gen331" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen332" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="2Kgs.6" sID="2Kgs.6"/>
et adhuc illo loquente eis apparuit nuntius qui veniebat ad eum et ait ecce tantum malum a Domino est quid amplius expectabo a Domino <chapter eID="2Kgs.6"/><div eID="gen332" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen333" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="2Kgs.7" sID="2Kgs.7"/>
evenit ergo ei sicut praedictum erat et conculcavit eum populus in porta et mortuus est <chapter eID="2Kgs.7"/><div eID="gen333" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen334" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="2Kgs.8" sID="2Kgs.8"/>

qui reversus est ut curaretur in Hiezrahel quia vulneraverant eum Syri in Rama proeliantem contra Azahel regem Syriae porro Ahazias filius Ioram rex Iuda descendit invisere Ioram filium Ahab in Hiezrahel quia aegrotabat <chapter eID="2Kgs.8"/><div eID="gen334" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen335" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="2Kgs.9" sID="2Kgs.9"/>
et erunt carnes Hiezabel sicut stercus super faciem terrae in agro Hiezrahel ita ut praetereuntes dicant haecine est illa Hiezabel <chapter eID="2Kgs.9"/><div eID="gen335" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen336" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="2Kgs.10" sID="2Kgs.10"/>
dies autem quos regnavit Hieu super Israhel viginti et octo anni sunt in Samaria <chapter eID="2Kgs.10"/><div eID="gen336" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen337" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="2Kgs.11" sID="2Kgs.11"/>
septemque annorum erat Ioas cum regnare coepisset <chapter eID="2Kgs.11"/><div eID="gen337" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen338" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="2Kgs.12" sID="2Kgs.12"/>

Iozachar namque filius Semath et Iozabad filius Somer servi eius percusserunt eum et mortuus est et sepelierunt eum cum patribus suis in civitate David regnavitque Amasias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.12"/><div eID="gen338" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen339" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="2Kgs.13" sID="2Kgs.13"/>

porro Ioas filius Ioachaz tulit urbes de manu Benadad filii Azahel quas tulerat de manu Ioachaz patris sui iure proelii tribus vicibus percussit eum Ioas et reddidit civitates Israheli <chapter eID="2Kgs.13"/><div eID="gen339" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen340" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="2Kgs.14" sID="2Kgs.14"/>
dormivitque Hieroboam cum patribus suis regibus Israhel et regnavit Zaccharias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.14"/><div eID="gen340" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen341" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="2Kgs.15" sID="2Kgs.15"/>
et dormivit Ioatham cum patribus suis sepultusque est cum eis in civitate David patris sui et regnavit Ahaz filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.15"/><div eID="gen341" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen342" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="2Kgs.16" sID="2Kgs.16"/>
dormivitque Ahaz cum patribus suis et sepultus est cum eis in civitate David et regnavit Ezechias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.16"/><div eID="gen342" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen343" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="2Kgs.17" sID="2Kgs.17"/>

fuerunt igitur gentes istae timentes quidem Dominum sed nihilominus et idolis suis servientes nam et filii eorum et nepotes sicut fecerunt parentes sui ita faciunt usque in praesentem diem <chapter eID="2Kgs.17"/><div eID="gen343" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen344" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="2Kgs.18" sID="2Kgs.18"/>

venitque Eliachim filius Helciae praepositus domus et Sobna scriba et Ioahe filius Asaph a commentariis ad Ezechiam scissis vestibus et nuntiaverunt ei verba Rabsacis <chapter eID="2Kgs.18"/><div eID="gen344" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen345" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="2Kgs.19" sID="2Kgs.19"/>

cumque adoraret in templo Neserach deum suum Adramelech et Sarasar filii eius percusserunt eum gladio fugeruntque in terram Armeniorum et regnavit Eseraddon filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.19"/><div eID="gen345" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen346" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="2Kgs.20" sID="2Kgs.20"/>
dormivitque Ezechias cum patribus suis et regnavit Manasses filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.20"/><div eID="gen346" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen347" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="2Kgs.21" sID="2Kgs.21"/>
sepelieruntque eum in sepulchro suo in horto Aza et regnavit Iosias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Kgs.21"/><div eID="gen347" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen348" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="2Kgs.22" sID="2Kgs.22"/>

idcirco colligam te ad patres tuos et colligeris ad sepulchrum tuum in pace ut non videant oculi tui omnia mala quae inducturus sum super locum istum <chapter eID="2Kgs.22"/><div eID="gen348" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen349" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="2Kgs.23" sID="2Kgs.23"/>
et fecit malum coram Domino iuxta omnia quae fecerant patres eius <chapter eID="2Kgs.23"/><div eID="gen349" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen350" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="2Kgs.24" sID="2Kgs.24"/>
irascebatur enim Dominus contra Hierusalem et contra Iudam donec proiceret eos a facie sua recessitque Sedecias a rege Babylonis <chapter eID="2Kgs.24"/><div eID="gen350" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen351" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="2Kgs.25" sID="2Kgs.25"/>

annonam quoque constituit ei absque intermissione quae et dabatur ei a rege per singulos dies omnibus diebus vitae suae <chapter eID="2Kgs.25"/><div eID="gen351" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen326" osisID="2Kgs" type="book"/>

1CH.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="1Chr" sID="gen352" type="book"/> <milestone n="I Paralipomenon" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="I Paralipomenon" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="I Par" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">I Paralipomenon</title> <div sID="gen353" type="x-p"/>
