<chapter n="1" osisID="1Chr.1" sID="1Chr.1"/>
dux Magdihel dux Iram hii duces Edom <chapter eID="1Chr.1"/><div eID="gen353" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen354" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="1Chr.2" sID="1Chr.2"/>

cognationes quoque scribarum habitantium in Iabis canentes atque resonantes et in tabernaculis commorantes hii sunt Cinei qui venerunt de calore patris domus Rechab <chapter eID="1Chr.2"/><div eID="gen354" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen355" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="1Chr.3" sID="1Chr.3"/>
filii Helioenai Oduia et Heliasub et Pheleia et Accub et Iohanan et Dalaia et Anani septem <chapter eID="1Chr.3"/><div eID="gen355" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen356" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="1Chr.4" sID="1Chr.4"/>
et percusserunt reliquias quae evadere potuerant Amalechitarum et habitaverunt ibi pro eis usque ad diem hanc <chapter eID="1Chr.4"/><div eID="gen356" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen357" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="1Chr.5" sID="1Chr.5"/>

et suscitavit Deus Israhel spiritum Ful regis Assyriorum et spiritum Theglathphalnasar regis Assur et transtulit Ruben et Gad et dimidium tribus Manasse et adduxit eos in Alae et Abor et Ara et fluvium Gozan usque ad diem hanc <chapter eID="1Chr.5"/><div eID="gen357" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen358" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="1Chr.6" sID="1Chr.6"/>
sed et Esbon cum suburbanis eius et Iezer cum suburbanis suis <chapter eID="1Chr.6"/><div eID="gen358" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen359" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="1Chr.7" sID="1Chr.7"/>

omnes hii filii Aser principes cognationum electi atque fortissimi duces ducum numerus autem eorum aetatis quae apta esset ad bellum viginti sex milia <chapter eID="1Chr.7"/><div eID="gen359" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen360" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="1Chr.8" sID="1Chr.8"/>

fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi et magno robore tendentes arcum et multos habentes filios ac nepotes usque ad centum quinquaginta omnes hii filii Beniamin <chapter eID="1Chr.8"/><div eID="gen360" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen361" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="1Chr.9" sID="1Chr.9"/>
porro Esel sex filios habuit his nominibus Ezricam Bochru Ismahel Saria Obdia Anan hii filii Esel <chapter eID="1Chr.9"/><div eID="gen361" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen362" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="1Chr.10" sID="1Chr.10"/>
nec speraverit in Domino propter quod et interfecit eum et transtulit regnum eius ad David filium Isai <chapter eID="1Chr.10"/><div eID="gen362" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen363" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="1Chr.11" sID="1Chr.11"/>
Elihel Maumites et Ieribai et Iosaia filii Elnaem et Iethma Moabites Elihel et Obed et Iasihel de Masobia <chapter eID="1Chr.11"/><div eID="gen363" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen364" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="1Chr.12" sID="1Chr.12"/>

sed et qui iuxta eos erant usque ad Isachar et Zabulon et Nepthalim adferebant panes in asinis et camelis et mulis et bubus ad vescendum farinam palatas uvam passam vinum oleum boves arietes ad omnem copiam gaudium quippe erat in Israhel <chapter eID="1Chr.12"/><div eID="gen364" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen365" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="1Chr.13" sID="1Chr.13"/>
mansit ergo arca Dei in domo Obededom tribus mensibus et benedixit Dominus domui eius et omnibus quae habebat <chapter eID="1Chr.13"/><div eID="gen365" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen366" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="1Chr.14" sID="1Chr.14"/>
divulgatumque est nomen David in universis regionibus et Dominus dedit pavorem eius super omnes gentes <chapter eID="1Chr.14"/><div eID="gen366" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen367" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="1Chr.15" sID="1Chr.15"/>

cumque pervenisset arca foederis Domini usque ad civitatem David Michol filia Saul prospiciens per fenestram vidit regem David saltantem atque ludentem et despexit eum in corde suo <chapter eID="1Chr.15"/><div eID="gen367" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen368" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="1Chr.16" sID="1Chr.16"/>
reversusque est omnis populus in domum suam et David ut benediceret etiam domui suae <chapter eID="1Chr.16"/><div eID="gen368" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen369" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="1Chr.17" sID="1Chr.17"/>
et coepisti benedicere domui servi tui ut sit semper coram te te enim Domine benedicente benedicta erit in perpetuum <chapter eID="1Chr.17"/><div eID="gen369" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen370" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="1Chr.18" sID="1Chr.18"/>
Banaias vero filius Ioiada super legiones Cherethi et Felethi porro filii David primi ad manum regis <chapter eID="1Chr.18"/><div eID="gen370" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen371" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="1Chr.19" sID="1Chr.19"/>

videntes autem servi Adadezer se ab Israhel esse superatos transfugerunt ad David et servierunt ei noluitque ultra Syria auxilium praebere filiis Ammon <chapter eID="1Chr.19"/><div eID="gen371" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen372" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="1Chr.20" sID="1Chr.20"/>

hic blasphemavit Israhel et percussit eum Ionathan filius Sammaa fratris David hii sunt filii Rapha in Geth qui ceciderunt in manu David et servorum eius <chapter eID="1Chr.20"/><div eID="gen372" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen373" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="1Chr.21" sID="1Chr.21"/>
et non praevaluit David ire ad altare ut ibi obsecraret Deum nimio enim fuerat timore perterritus videns gladium angeli Domini <chapter eID="1Chr.21"/><div eID="gen373" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen374" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="1Chr.22" sID="1Chr.22"/>

praebete igitur corda vestra et animas vestras ut quaeratis Dominum Deum vestrum et consurgite et aedificate sanctuarium Domino Deo ut introducatur arca foederis Domini et vasa Domino consecrata in domum quae aedificatur nomini Domini <chapter eID="1Chr.22"/><div eID="gen374" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen375" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="1Chr.23" sID="1Chr.23"/>
et custodiant observationes tabernaculi foederis et ritum sanctuarii et observationem filiorum Aaron fratrum suorum ut ministrent in domo Domini <chapter eID="1Chr.23"/><div eID="gen375" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen376" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="1Chr.24" sID="1Chr.24"/>

miseruntque et ipsi sortes contra fratres suos filios Aaron coram David rege et Sadoc et Ahimelech et principibus familiarum sacerdotalium et leviticarum tam maiores quam minores omnes sors aequaliter dividebat <chapter eID="1Chr.24"/><div eID="gen376" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen377" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="1Chr.25" sID="1Chr.25"/>
vicesima quarta Romamthiezer filiis et fratribus eius duodecim <chapter eID="1Chr.25"/><div eID="gen377" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen378" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="1Chr.26" sID="1Chr.26"/>

fratresque eius robustioris aetatis duo milia septingenti principes familiarum praeposuit autem eos David rex Rubenitis et Gadditis et dimidio tribus Manasse in omne ministerium Dei et regis <chapter eID="1Chr.26"/><div eID="gen378" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen379" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="1Chr.27" sID="1Chr.27"/>
post Ahitophel fuit Ioiada filius Banaiae et Abiathar princeps autem exercitus regis erat Ioab <chapter eID="1Chr.27"/><div eID="gen379" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen380" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="1Chr.28" sID="1Chr.28"/>

ecce divisiones sacerdotum et Levitarum in omne ministerium domus Domini adsistunt tibi et parati sunt et noverunt tam principes quam populus facere omnia praecepta tua <chapter eID="1Chr.28"/><div eID="gen380" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen381" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="1Chr.29" sID="1Chr.29"/>

universique regni eius et fortitudinis et temporum quae transierunt sub eo sive in Israhel sive in cunctis regnis terrarum <chapter eID="1Chr.29"/><div eID="gen381" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen352" osisID="1Chr" type="book"/>

2CH.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="2Chr" sID="gen382" type="book"/> <milestone n="II Paralipomenon" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="II Paralipomenon" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="II Par" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">II Paralipomenon</title> <div sID="gen383" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="2Chr.1" sID="2Chr.1"/>

quadrigam equorum sescentis argenteis et equum centum quinquaginta similiter de universis regnis Cettheorum et a regibus Syriae emptio celebrabatur <chapter eID="2Chr.1"/><div eID="gen383" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen384" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="2Chr.2" sID="2Chr.2"/>

fecitque ex eis septuaginta milia qui umeris onera portarent et octoginta milia qui lapides in montibus caederent tria milia autem et sescentos praepositos operum populi <chapter eID="2Chr.2"/><div eID="gen384" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen385" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="2Chr.3" sID="2Chr.3"/>

ipsas quoque columnas posuit in vestibulo templi unam a dextris et alteram a sinistris eam quae a dextris erat vocavit Iachin et quae ad levam Booz <chapter eID="2Chr.3"/><div eID="gen385" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen386" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="2Chr.4" sID="2Chr.4"/>

thymiamateria quoque et turibula et fialas et mortariola ex auro purissimo et ostia celavit templi interioris id est in sancto sanctorum et ostia templi forinsecus aurea sicque conpletum est omne opus quod fecit Salomon in domo Domini <chapter eID="2Chr.4"/><div eID="gen386" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen387" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="2Chr.5" sID="2Chr.5"/>
nec possent sacerdotes stare et ministrare propter caliginem conpleverat enim gloria Domini domum Dei <chapter eID="2Chr.5"/><div eID="gen387" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen388" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="2Chr.6" sID="2Chr.6"/>
Domine Deus ne averseris faciem christi tui memento misericordiarum David servi tui <chapter eID="2Chr.6"/><div eID="gen388" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen389" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="2Chr.7" sID="2Chr.7"/>

respondebuntque quia dereliquerunt Dominum Deum patrum suorum qui eduxit eos de terra Aegypti et adprehenderunt deos alienos et adoraverunt eos atque coluerunt idcirco venerunt super eos universa haec mala <chapter eID="2Chr.7"/><div eID="gen389" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen390" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="2Chr.8" sID="2Chr.8"/>

misit autem ei Hiram per manum servorum suorum naves et nautas gnaros maris et abierunt cum servis Salomonis in Ophir tuleruntque inde quadringenta quinquaginta talenta auri et adtulerunt ad regem Salomonem <chapter eID="2Chr.8"/><div eID="gen390" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen391" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="2Chr.9" sID="2Chr.9"/>
dormivitque cum patribus suis et sepelierunt eum in civitate David regnavitque pro eo Roboam filius eius <chapter eID="2Chr.9"/><div eID="gen391" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen392" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="2Chr.10" sID="2Chr.10"/>
recessitque Israhel a domo David usque ad diem hanc <chapter eID="2Chr.10"/><div eID="gen392" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen393" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="2Chr.11" sID="2Chr.11"/>

qui sapientior fuit et potentior super omnes filios eius et in cunctis finibus Iuda et Beniamin et in universis civitatibus muratis praebuitque eis escas plurimas et multas petivit uxores <chapter eID="2Chr.11"/><div eID="gen393" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen394" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="2Chr.12" sID="2Chr.12"/>
et dormivit Roboam cum patribus suis sepultusque est in civitate David et regnavit Abia filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.12"/><div eID="gen394" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen395" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="2Chr.13" sID="2Chr.13"/>
reliqua autem sermonum Abia viarumque et operum eius scripta sunt diligentissime in libro prophetae Addo <chapter eID="2Chr.13"/><div eID="gen395" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen396" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="2Chr.14" sID="2Chr.14"/>
sed et caulas ovium destruentes tulerunt pecorum infinitam multitudinem et camelorum reversique sunt Hierusalem <chapter eID="2Chr.14"/><div eID="gen396" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen397" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="2Chr.15" sID="2Chr.15"/>
bellum vero non fuit usque ad tricesimum quintum annum regni Asa <chapter eID="2Chr.15"/><div eID="gen397" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen398" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="2Chr.16" sID="2Chr.16"/>

et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro suo quod foderat sibi in civitate David posueruntque eum super lectulum suum plenum aromatibus et unguentis meretriciis quae erant pigmentariorum arte confecta et conbuserunt super eum ambitione nimia <chapter eID="2Chr.16"/><div eID="gen398" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen399" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="2Chr.17" sID="2Chr.17"/>
hii omnes erant ad manum regis exceptis aliis quos posuerat in urbibus muratis et in universo Iuda <chapter eID="2Chr.17"/><div eID="gen399" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen400" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="2Chr.18" sID="2Chr.18"/>
et finita est pugna in die illo porro rex Israhel stabat in curru suo contra Syros usque ad vesperam et mortuus est occidente sole <chapter eID="2Chr.18"/><div eID="gen400" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen401" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="2Chr.19" sID="2Chr.19"/>

Amarias autem sacerdos et pontifex vester in his quae ad Dominum pertinent praesidebit porro Zabadias filius Ismahel qui est dux in domo Iuda super ea opera erit quae ad regis officium pertinent habetisque magistros Levitas coram vobis confortamini et agite diligenter et erit Dominus cum bonis <chapter eID="2Chr.19"/><div eID="gen401" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen402" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="2Chr.20" sID="2Chr.20"/>

prophetavit autem Eliezer filius Dodoau de Maresa ad Iosaphat dicens quia habuisti foedus cum Ochozia percussit Dominus opera tua contritaeque sunt naves nec potuerunt ire in Tharsis <chapter eID="2Chr.20"/><div eID="gen402" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen403" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="2Chr.21" sID="2Chr.21"/>

triginta duum annorum fuit cum regnare coepisset et octo annis regnavit in Hierusalem ambulavitque non recte et sepelierunt eum in civitate David verumtamen non in sepulchro regum <chapter eID="2Chr.21"/><div eID="gen403" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen404" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="2Chr.22" sID="2Chr.22"/>
fuit ergo cum eis in domo Dei absconditus sex annis quibus regnavit Otholia super terram <chapter eID="2Chr.22"/><div eID="gen404" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen405" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="2Chr.23" sID="2Chr.23"/>
laetatusque est omnis populus terrae et urbs quievit porro Otholia interfecta est gladio <chapter eID="2Chr.23"/><div eID="gen405" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen406" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="2Chr.24" sID="2Chr.24"/>

porro filii eius ac summa pecuniae quae adunata fuerat sub eo et instauratio domus Dei scripta sunt diligentius in libro regum regnavitque Amasias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.24"/><div eID="gen406" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen407" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="2Chr.25" sID="2Chr.25"/>
reportantesque super equos sepelierunt eum cum patribus suis in civitate David <chapter eID="2Chr.25"/><div eID="gen407" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen408" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="2Chr.26" sID="2Chr.26"/>

dormivitque Ozias cum patribus suis et sepelierunt eum in agro regalium sepulchrorum eo quod esset leprosus regnavitque Ioatham filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.26"/><div eID="gen408" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen409" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="2Chr.27" sID="2Chr.27"/>
dormivitque Ioatham cum patribus suis et sepelierunt eum in civitate David et regnavit Achaz filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.27"/><div eID="gen409" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen410" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="2Chr.28" sID="2Chr.28"/>

dormivitque Achaz cum patribus suis et sepelierunt eum in civitate Hierusalem neque enim receperunt eum in sepulchra regum Israhel regnavitque Ezechias filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.28"/><div eID="gen410" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen411" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="2Chr.29" sID="2Chr.29"/>
laetatusque est Ezechias et omnis populus eo quod ministerium Domini esset expletum de repente quippe hoc fieri placuerat <chapter eID="2Chr.29"/><div eID="gen411" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen412" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="2Chr.30" sID="2Chr.30"/>
surrexerunt autem sacerdotes atque Levitae benedicentes populo et exaudita est vox eorum pervenitque oratio in habitaculum sanctum caeli <chapter eID="2Chr.30"/><div eID="gen412" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen413" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="2Chr.31" sID="2Chr.31"/>
in universa cultura ministerii domus Domini iuxta legem et caerimonias volens requirere Deum suum in toto corde suo fecitque et prosperatus est <chapter eID="2Chr.31"/><div eID="gen413" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen414" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="2Chr.32" sID="2Chr.32"/>

dormivitque Ezechias cum patribus suis et sepelierunt eum supra sepulchra filiorum David et celebravit eius exequias universus Iuda et omnes habitatores Hierusalem regnavitque Manasses filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.32"/><div eID="gen414" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen415" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="2Chr.33" sID="2Chr.33"/>
porro reliqua populi multitudo caesis his qui Amon percusserant constituit regem Iosiam filium eius pro eo <chapter eID="2Chr.33"/><div eID="gen415" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen416" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="2Chr.34" sID="2Chr.34"/>

abstulit ergo Iosias cunctas abominationes de universis regionibus filiorum Israhel et fecit omnes qui residui erant in Israhel servire Domino Deo suo cunctis diebus eius non recesserunt a Domino Deo patrum suorum <chapter eID="2Chr.34"/><div eID="gen416" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen417" type="x-p"/><chapter n="35" osisID="2Chr.35" sID="2Chr.35"/>
opera quoque illius prima et novissima scripta sunt in libro regum Israhel et Iuda <chapter eID="2Chr.35"/><div eID="gen417" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen418" type="x-p"/><chapter n="36" osisID="2Chr.36" sID="2Chr.36"/>

haec dicit Cyrus rex Persarum omnia regna terrae dedit mihi Dominus Deus caeli et ipse praecepit mihi ut aedificarem ei domum in Hierusalem quae est in Iudaea quis ex vobis est in omni populo eius sit Dominus Deus suus cum eo et ascendat <chapter eID="2Chr.36"/><div eID="gen418" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen382" osisID="2Chr" type="book"/>

EZR.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Ezra" sID="gen421" type="book"/> <milestone n="Esdrae" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Esdrae" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Esd" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Esdrae</title> <div sID="gen422" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Ezra.1" sID="Ezra.1"/>

omnia vasa aurea et argentea quinque milia quadringenta universa tulit Sasabassar cum his qui ascendebant de transmigratione Babylonis in Hierusalem <chapter eID="Ezra.1"/><div eID="gen422" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen423" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Ezra.2" sID="Ezra.2"/>

habitaverunt ergo sacerdotes et Levitae et de populo et cantores et ianitores et Nathinnei in urbibus suis universusque Israhel in civitatibus suis <chapter eID="Ezra.2"/><div eID="gen423" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen424" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Ezra.3" sID="Ezra.3"/>

nec poterat quisquam agnoscere vocem clamoris laetantium et vocem fletus populi commixtim enim populus vociferabatur clamore magno et vox audiebatur procul <chapter eID="Ezra.3"/><div eID="gen424" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen425" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Ezra.4" sID="Ezra.4"/>
tunc intermissum est opus domus Dei in Hierusalem et non fiebat usque ad annum secundum regni Darii regis Persarum <chapter eID="Ezra.4"/><div eID="gen425" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen426" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Ezra.5" sID="Ezra.5"/>

nunc ergo si videtur regi bonum recenseat in bibliotheca regis quae est in Babylone utrumnam a Cyro rege iussum sit ut aedificaretur domus Dei in Hierusalem et voluntatem regis super hac re mittat ad nos <chapter eID="Ezra.5"/><div eID="gen426" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen427" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Ezra.6" sID="Ezra.6"/>

et fecerunt sollemnitatem azymorum septem diebus in laetitia quoniam laetificaverat eos Dominus et converterat cor regis Assur ad eos ut adiuvaret manus eorum in opere domus Domini Dei Israhel <chapter eID="Ezra.6"/><div eID="gen427" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen428" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Ezra.7" sID="Ezra.7"/>

et in me inclinavit misericordiam coram rege et consiliatoribus eius et universis principibus regis potentibus et ego confortatus manu Domini Dei mei quae erat in me congregavi de Israhel principes qui ascenderent mecum <chapter eID="Ezra.7"/><div eID="gen428" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen429" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Ezra.8" sID="Ezra.8"/>
dederunt autem edicta regis satrapis qui erant de conspectu regis et ducibus trans Flumen et elevaverunt populum et domum Dei <chapter eID="Ezra.8"/><div eID="gen429" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen430" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Ezra.9" sID="Ezra.9"/>

Domine Deus Israhel iustus tu quoniam derelicti sumus qui salvaremur sicut die hac ecce coram te sumus in delicto nostro non enim stari potest coram te super hoc <chapter eID="Ezra.9"/><div eID="gen430" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen431" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Ezra.10" sID="Ezra.10"/>

omnes hii acceperunt uxores alienigenas et fuerunt ex eis mulieres quae pepererant filios <chapter eID="Ezra.10"/><div eID="gen431" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen421" osisID="Ezra" type="book"/>

NEH.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Neh" sID="gen432" type="book"/> <milestone n="Nehemiæ" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Nehemiæ" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Neh" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Nehemiae</title> <div sID="gen433" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Neh.1" sID="Neh.1"/>

obsecro Domine sit auris tua adtendens ad orationem servi tui et ad orationem servorum tuorum qui volunt timere nomen tuum et dirige servum tuum hodie et da ei misericordiam ante virum hunc ego enim eram pincerna regis <chapter eID="Neh.1"/><div eID="gen433" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen434" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Neh.2" sID="Neh.2"/>

et reddidi eis sermonem dixique ad eos Deus caeli ipse nos iuvat et nos servi eius sumus surgamus et aedificemus vobis autem non est pars et iustitia et memoria in Hierusalem <chapter eID="Neh.2"/><div eID="gen434" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen435" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Neh.3" sID="Neh.3"/>
et inter cenaculum Anguli in porta Gregis aedificaverunt artifices et negotiatores <chapter eID="Neh.3"/><div eID="gen435" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen436" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Neh.4" sID="Neh.4"/>
ego autem et fratres mei et pueri mei et custodes qui erant post me non deponebamus vestimenta nostra unusquisque tantum nudabatur ad baptismum <chapter eID="Neh.4"/><div eID="gen436" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen437" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Neh.5" sID="Neh.5"/>
memento mei Deus meus in bonum secundum omnia quae feci populo huic <chapter eID="Neh.5"/><div eID="gen437" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen438" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Neh.6" sID="Neh.6"/>
sed et laudabant eum coram me et verba mea nuntiabant ei et Tobias mittebat epistulas ut terreret me <chapter eID="Neh.6"/><div eID="gen438" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen439" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Neh.7" sID="Neh.7"/>
habitaverunt autem sacerdotes et Levitae et ianitores et cantores et reliquum vulgus et Nathinnei et omnis Israhel in civitatibus suis <chapter eID="Neh.7"/><div eID="gen439" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen440" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Neh.8" sID="Neh.8"/>

legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos a die primo usque ad diem novissimum et fecerunt sollemnitatem septem diebus et in die octavo collectum iuxta ritum <chapter eID="Neh.8"/><div eID="gen440" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen441" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Neh.9" sID="Neh.9"/>
super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus foedus et scribimus et signant principes nostri Levitae nostri et sacerdotes nostri <chapter eID="Neh.9"/><div eID="gen441" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen442" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Neh.10" sID="Neh.10"/>

ad gazofilacium enim deportabunt filii Israhel et filii Levi primitias frumenti vini et olei et ibi erunt vasa sanctificata et sacerdotes et cantores et ianitores et ministri et non dimittemus domum Dei nostri <chapter eID="Neh.10"/><div eID="gen442" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen443" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Neh.11" sID="Neh.11"/>
et de Levitis partitiones Iuda et Beniamin <chapter eID="Neh.11"/><div eID="gen443" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen444" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Neh.12" sID="Neh.12"/>

et omnis Israhel in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Neemiae dabat partes cantoribus et ianitoribus per dies singulos et sanctificabant Levitas et Levitae sanctificabant filios Aaron <chapter eID="Neh.12"/><div eID="gen444" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen445" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Neh.13" sID="Neh.13"/>

et in oblatione lignorum in temporibus constitutis et in primitiis memento mei Deus meus in bonum <chapter eID="Neh.13"/><div eID="gen445" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen432" osisID="Neh" type="book"/>

TOB.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Tob" sID="gen446" type="book"/> <milestone n="Tobiae" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Tobiae" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Tob" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Tobiae</title> <div sID="gen447" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Tob.1" sID="Tob.1"/>
et reversus est Tobias ad domum suam omnisque facultas eius restituta est ei <chapter eID="Tob.1"/><div eID="gen447" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen448" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Tob.2" sID="Tob.2"/>
atque his et aliis huiusmodi verbis exprobrabat ei <chapter eID="Tob.2"/><div eID="gen448" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen449" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Tob.3" sID="Tob.3"/>
et missus est angelus Domini sanctus Rafahel ut curaret ambos quorum uno tempore fuerat oratio in conspectu Domini recitata <chapter eID="Tob.3"/><div eID="gen449" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen450" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Tob.4" sID="Tob.4"/>
noli timere fili mi pauperem quidem vitam gerimus sed multa bona habemus si timuerimus Deum et recesserimus ab omni peccato et fecerimus bene <chapter eID="Tob.4"/><div eID="gen450" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen451" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Tob.5" sID="Tob.5"/>
ad hanc vocem cessavit mater eius flere et tacuit <chapter eID="Tob.5"/><div eID="gen451" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen452" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Tob.6" sID="Tob.6"/>

transacta autem tertia nocte accipies virginem cum timore Domini amore filiorum magis quam libidinis ductus ut in semine Abrahae benedictionem in filiis consequaris <chapter eID="Tob.6"/><div eID="gen452" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen453" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Tob.7" sID="Tob.7"/>
dixitque ei forti animo esto filia mi Dominus caeli det tibi gaudium pro taedio quo perpessa es <chapter eID="Tob.7"/><div eID="gen453" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen454" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Tob.8" sID="Tob.8"/>

de omnibus autem quae possidebat Raguhel dimidiam partem dedit Tobiae et fecit hanc scripturam ut pars dimidia quae supererat post obitum eorum Tobis dominio deveniret <chapter eID="Tob.8"/><div eID="gen454" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen455" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Tob.9" sID="Tob.9"/>
cumque omnes dixissent amen accesserunt ad convivium sed et cum timore Domini nuptiarum convivium exercebant <chapter eID="Tob.9"/><div eID="gen455" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen456" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Tob.10" sID="Tob.10"/>
monentes eam honorare soceros diligere maritum regere familiam gubernare domum et se ipsam inreprehensibilem exhibere <chapter eID="Tob.10"/><div eID="gen456" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen457" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Tob.11" sID="Tob.11"/>
et per septem dies epulantes omnes gaudio magno gavisi sunt <chapter eID="Tob.11"/><div eID="gen457" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen458" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Tob.12" sID="Tob.12"/>
tunc prostrati per horas tres in faciem benedixerunt Deum et exsurgentes narraverunt omnia mirabilia eius <chapter eID="Tob.12"/><div eID="gen458" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen459" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Tob.13" sID="Tob.13"/>
benedictus Dominus qui excitavit eam ut sit regnum eius in saecula saeculorum super eam amen <chapter eID="Tob.13"/><div eID="gen459" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen460" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Tob.14" sID="Tob.14"/>

omnis cognatio eius et omnis generatio eius in bona vita et sancta conversatione permansit ita ut accepti essent tam Deo quam hominibus et cunctis habitatoribus terrae <chapter eID="Tob.14"/><div eID="gen460" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen446" osisID="Tob" type="book"/>

JDT.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Jdt" sID="gen461" type="book"/> <milestone n="Iudith" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Iudith" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Iudith" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Iudith</title> <div sID="gen462" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Jdt.1" sID="Jdt.1"/>
tunc indignatus est Nabuchodonosor rex ad omnem terram illam et iuravit per regnum et thronum suum quod defenderet se de omnibus regionibus his <chapter eID="Jdt.1"/><div eID="gen462" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen463" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Jdt.2" sID="Jdt.2"/>
et cecidit timor illius super omnes inhabitantes terram <chapter eID="Jdt.2"/><div eID="gen463" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen464" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Jdt.3" sID="Jdt.3"/>
accepitque civitates eorum et sedit ibi per triginta dies in quibus diebus adunari praecepit universum exercitum virtutis suae <chapter eID="Jdt.3"/><div eID="gen464" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen465" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Jdt.4" sID="Jdt.4"/>
et ex toto corde suo omnes orabant Deum ut visitaret populum suum Israhel <chapter eID="Jdt.4"/><div eID="gen465" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen466" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Jdt.5" sID="Jdt.5"/>
ut sciat omnis gens quoniam Nabuchodonosor deus terrae est et praeter ipsum alius non est <chapter eID="Jdt.5"/><div eID="gen466" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen467" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Jdt.6" sID="Jdt.6"/>
postea vero convocatus omnis populus et per totam noctem intra ecclesiam oraverunt petentes auxilium a Deo Israhel <chapter eID="Jdt.6"/><div eID="gen467" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen468" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Jdt.7" sID="Jdt.7"/>
si autem transactis quinque diebus non venerit adiutorium faciemus haec verba quae locuti estis <chapter eID="Jdt.7"/><div eID="gen468" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen469" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Jdt.8" sID="Jdt.8"/>
et dixit ad eam Ozias princeps Iudaeae vade in pace et Dominus sit tecum in ultione inimicorum nostrorum et revertentes abierunt <chapter eID="Jdt.8"/><div eID="gen469" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen470" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Jdt.9" sID="Jdt.9"/>
et omnes gentes agnoscant quoniam tu es Deus et non est alius praeter te <chapter eID="Jdt.9"/><div eID="gen470" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen471" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Jdt.10" sID="Jdt.10"/>
et cum in faciem eius intendisset adoravit eum prosternens se super terram et levaverunt illam servi Holofernis iubente domino suo <chapter eID="Jdt.10"/><div eID="gen471" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen472" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Jdt.11" sID="Jdt.11"/>

et quoniam bona est promissio tua si fecerit mihi hoc Deus tuus erit et meus Deus et tu in domo Nabuchodonosor magna eris et nomen tuum nominabitur in universa terra <chapter eID="Jdt.11"/><div eID="gen472" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen473" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Jdt.12" sID="Jdt.12"/>
et iucundus factus est Holofernis ad illam bibitque vinum nimis multum quantum numquam biberat in vita sua <chapter eID="Jdt.12"/><div eID="gen473" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen474" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Jdt.13" sID="Jdt.13"/>
benedicta tu Deo tuo in omni tabernaculo Iacob quoniam in omni gente quae audierit nomen tuum magnificabit Deum Israhel super te <chapter eID="Jdt.13"/><div eID="gen474" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen475" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Jdt.14" sID="Jdt.14"/>
et factus est clamor inconparabilis in media castra eorum <chapter eID="Jdt.14"/><div eID="gen475" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen476" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Jdt.15" sID="Jdt.15"/>
et omnes populi gaudebant cum mulieribus et virginibus et iuvenibus in organis et citharis <chapter eID="Jdt.15"/><div eID="gen476" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen477" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Jdt.16" sID="Jdt.16"/>

dies autem victoriae huius festivitatem ab Hebraeis in numero dierum sanctorum accepit et colitur a Iudaeis ex illo tempore usque in praesentem diem <chapter eID="Jdt.16"/><div eID="gen477" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen461" osisID="Jdt" type="book"/>

EST.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Esth" sID="gen478" type="book"/> <milestone n="Esther" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Esther" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Est" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Esther</title> <div sID="gen479" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Esth.1" sID="Esth.1"/>
in diebus Asueri<note placement="foot">Cf. <reference type="annotateRef">Est 11,2-12,6</reference></note> qui regnavit ab India usque Aethiopiam super centum viginti septem provincias

et misit epistulas ad universas provincias regni sui ut quaeque gens audire et legere poterat diversis linguis et litteris esse viros principes ac maiores in domibus suis et hoc per cunctos populos divulgari  <chapter eID="Esth.1"/><div eID="gen479" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen480" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Esth.2" sID="Esth.2"/>
quaesitum est et inventum et adpensus uterque eorum in patibulo mandatumque historiis et annalibus traditum coram rege <chapter eID="Esth.2"/><div eID="gen480" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen481" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Esth.3" sID="Esth.3"/>

missae sunt per cursores regis ad universas provincias ut occiderent atque delerent omnes Iudaeos a puero usque ad senem parvulos et mulieres uno die hoc est tertiodecimo mensis duodecimi qui vocatur adar et bona eorum diriperent<note placement="foot">Cf. <reference type="annotateRef">Est 13,1-7</reference></note>

festinabant cursores qui missi erant explere regis imperium statimque in Susis pependit edictum rege et Aman celebrante convivium et cunctis qui in urbe erant flentibus <chapter eID="Esth.3"/><div eID="gen481" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen482" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Esth.4" sID="Esth.4"/>

exemplarque edicti quod pendebat in Susis dedit ei ut reginae ostenderet et moneret eam ut intraret ad regem et deprecaretur eum pro populo suo<note placement="foot">Cf. <reference type="annotateRef">Est 15,1-3</reference></note>

ivit itaque Mardocheus et fecit omnia quae ei Hester praeceperat<note placement="foot">Cf. <reference type="annotateRef">Est 13,8-14,19 ; 15,4-19</reference></note><chapter eID="Esth.4"/><div eID="gen482" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen483" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Esth.5" sID="Esth.5"/>

responderuntque ei Zares uxor eius et ceteri amici iube parari excelsam trabem habentem altitudinem quinquaginta cubitos et dic mane regi ut adpendatur super eam Mardocheus et sic ibis cum rege laetus ad convivium placuit ei consilium et iussit excelsam parari crucem <chapter eID="Esth.5"/><div eID="gen483" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen484" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Esth.6" sID="Esth.6"/>
adhuc illis loquentibus venerunt eunuchi regis et cito eum ad convivium quod regina paraverat pergere conpulerunt <chapter eID="Esth.6"/><div eID="gen484" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen485" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Esth.7" sID="Esth.7"/>
suspensus est itaque Aman in patibulo quod paraverat Mardocheo et regis ira quievit <chapter eID="Esth.7"/><div eID="gen485" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen486" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Esth.8" sID="Esth.8"/>
et constituta est per omnes provincias una ultionis dies id est tertiadecima mensis duodecimi adar<note placement="foot">Cf. <reference type="annotateRef">Est 16,1-24</reference></note>

apud omnes populos urbes atque provincias quocumque regis iussa veniebant mira exultatio epulae atque convivia et festus dies in tantum ut plures alterius gentis et sectae eorum religioni et caerimoniis iungerentur grandis enim cunctos iudaici nominis terror invaserat <chapter eID="Esth.8"/><div eID="gen486" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen487" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Esth.9" sID="Esth.9"/>
et omnia quae libri huius qui vocatur Hester historia continentur <chapter eID="Esth.9"/><div eID="gen487" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen488" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Esth.10" sID="Esth.10"/>

Et observabuntur dies isti in mense Adar quartadecima et quintadecima die eiusdem mensis cum omni studio et gaudio in unum coetum populi congregati in cunctas deinceps generationes populi Israel <chapter eID="Esth.10"/><div eID="gen488" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen489" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Esth.11" sID="Esth.11"/>

Anno quarto regnantibus Ptolemaeo et Cleopatra attulerunt Dosithaeus qui se Sacerdotem et Levitici generis ferebat et Ptolemaeus filius eius hanc epistolam phurim quam dixerunt interpretatum esse Lysimachum Ptolemaei filium in Ierusalem<note placement="foot">Cf <reference type="annotateRef">Est 1,1</reference></note>

Quod cum vidisset Mardochaeus et surrexisset de strato cogitabat quid Deus facere vellet et fixum habebat in animo scire cupiens quid significaret somnium <chapter eID="Esth.11"/><div eID="gen489" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen490" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Esth.12" sID="Esth.12"/>

Aman vero filius Amadathi bugaeus erat gloriosissimus coram rege et voluit nocere Mardochaeo et populo eius pro duobus eunuchis regis qui fuerant interfecti <chapter eID="Esth.12"/><div eID="gen490" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen491" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Esth.13" sID="Esth.13"/>
Omnis quoque Israel pari mente et obsecratione clamavit ad Dominum eo quod eis certa mors impenderet <chapter eID="Esth.13"/><div eID="gen491" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen492" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Esth.14" sID="Esth.14"/>
Deus fortis super omnes exaudi vocem eorum qui nullam aliam spem habent et libera nos de manu iniquorum et erue me a timore meo <chapter eID="Esth.14"/><div eID="gen492" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen493" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Esth.15" sID="Esth.15"/>
Rex autem turbabatur et omnes ministri eius consolabantur eam <chapter eID="Esth.15"/><div eID="gen493" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen494" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Esth.16" sID="Esth.16"/>

Omnis autem provincia et civitas quae noluerit sollemnitatis huius esse particeps gladio et igne pereat et sic deleatur ut non solum hominibus sed etiam bestiis invia sit in sempiternum pro exemplo contemptus et inobedientiae <chapter eID="Esth.16"/><div eID="gen494" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen478" osisID="Esth" type="book"/>

JOB.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Job" sID="gen495" type="book"/> <milestone n="Iob" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Iob" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Iob" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Iob</title> <div sID="gen496" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Job.1" sID="Job.1"/>
in omnibus his non peccavit Iob neque stultum quid contra Deum locutus est <chapter eID="Job.1"/><div eID="gen496" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen497" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Job.2" sID="Job.2"/>
et sederunt cum eo in terram septem diebus et septem noctibus et nemo loquebatur ei verbum videbant enim dolorem esse vehementem <chapter eID="Job.2"/><div eID="gen497" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen498" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Job.3" sID="Job.3"/>
nonne dissimulavi nonne silui nonne quievi et venit super me indignatio <chapter eID="Job.3"/><div eID="gen498" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen499" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Job.4" sID="Job.4"/>
qui autem reliqui fuerint auferentur ex eis morientur et non in sapientia <chapter eID="Job.4"/><div eID="gen499" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen500" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Job.5" sID="Job.5"/>
ecce hoc ut investigavimus ita est quod auditum mente pertracta <chapter eID="Job.5"/><div eID="gen500" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen501" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Job.6" sID="Job.6"/>
et non invenietis in lingua mea iniquitatem nec in faucibus meis stultitia personabit <chapter eID="Job.6"/><div eID="gen501" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen502" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Job.7" sID="Job.7"/>
cur non tolles peccatum meum et quare non auferes iniquitatem meam ecce nunc in pulvere dormiam et si mane me quaesieris non subsistam <chapter eID="Job.7"/><div eID="gen502" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen503" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Job.8" sID="Job.8"/>
qui oderunt te induentur confusione et tabernaculum impiorum non subsistet <chapter eID="Job.8"/><div eID="gen503" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen504" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Job.9" sID="Job.9"/>
loquar et non timebo eum neque enim possum metuens respondere <chapter eID="Job.9"/><div eID="gen504" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen505" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Job.10" sID="Job.10"/>
terram miseriae et tenebrarum ubi umbra mortis et nullus ordo et sempiternus horror inhabitans <chapter eID="Job.10"/><div eID="gen505" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen506" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Job.11" sID="Job.11"/>
oculi autem impiorum deficient et effugium peribit ab eis et spes eorum abominatio animae <chapter eID="Job.11"/><div eID="gen506" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen507" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Job.12" sID="Job.12"/>
palpabunt quasi in tenebris et non in luce et errare eos faciet quasi ebrios <chapter eID="Job.12"/><div eID="gen507" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen508" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Job.13" sID="Job.13"/>
qui quasi putredo consumendus sum et quasi vestimentum quod comeditur a tinea <chapter eID="Job.13"/><div eID="gen508" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen509" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Job.14" sID="Job.14"/>
attamen caro eius dum vivet dolebit et anima illius super semet ipso lugebit <chapter eID="Job.14"/><div eID="gen509" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen510" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Job.15" sID="Job.15"/>
concepit dolorem et peperit iniquitatem et uterus eius praeparat dolos <chapter eID="Job.15"/><div eID="gen510" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen511" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Job.16" sID="Job.16"/>
ecce enim breves anni transeunt et semitam per quam non revertar ambulo <chapter eID="Job.16"/><div eID="gen511" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen512" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Job.17" sID="Job.17"/>
in profundissimum infernum descendent omnia mea putasne saltim ibi erit requies mihi <chapter eID="Job.17"/><div eID="gen512" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen513" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Job.18" sID="Job.18"/>
haec sunt ergo tabernacula iniqui et iste locus eius qui ignorat Deum <chapter eID="Job.18"/><div eID="gen513" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen514" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Job.19" sID="Job.19"/>
fugite ergo a facie gladii quoniam ultor iniquitatum gladius est et scitote esse iudicium <chapter eID="Job.19"/><div eID="gen514" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen515" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Job.20" sID="Job.20"/>
haec est pars hominis impii a Deo et hereditas verborum eius a Domino <chapter eID="Job.20"/><div eID="gen515" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen516" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Job.21" sID="Job.21"/>
quomodo igitur consolamini me frustra cum responsio vestra repugnare ostensa sit veritati <chapter eID="Job.21"/><div eID="gen516" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen517" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Job.22" sID="Job.22"/>
salvabitur innocens salvabitur autem munditia manuum suarum <chapter eID="Job.22"/><div eID="gen517" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen518" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Job.23" sID="Job.23"/>
non enim perii propter inminentes tenebras nec faciem meam operuit caligo <chapter eID="Job.23"/><div eID="gen518" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen519" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Job.24" sID="Job.24"/>
quod si non est ita quis me potest arguere esse mentitum et ponere ante Deum verba mea <chapter eID="Job.24"/><div eID="gen519" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen520" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Job.25" sID="Job.25"/>
quanto magis homo putredo et filius hominis vermis <chapter eID="Job.25"/><div eID="gen520" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen521" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Job.26" sID="Job.26"/>
ecce haec ex parte dicta sunt viarum eius et cum vix parvam stillam sermonis eius audierimus quis poterit tonitruum magnitudinis illius intueri <chapter eID="Job.26"/><div eID="gen521" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen522" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Job.27" sID="Job.27"/>
stringet super eum manus suas et sibilabit super illum intuens locum eius <chapter eID="Job.27"/><div eID="gen522" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen523" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Job.28" sID="Job.28"/>
et dixit homini ecce timor Domini ipsa est sapientia et recedere a malo intellegentia <chapter eID="Job.28"/><div eID="gen523" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen524" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="Job.29" sID="Job.29"/>
si voluissem ire ad eos sedebam primus cumque sederem quasi rex circumstante exercitu eram tamen maerentium consolator <chapter eID="Job.29"/><div eID="gen524" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen525" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="Job.30" sID="Job.30"/>
versa est in luctum cithara mea et organum meum in vocem flentium <chapter eID="Job.30"/><div eID="gen525" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen526" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Job.31" sID="Job.31"/>
pro frumento oriatur mihi tribulus et pro hordeo spina finita sunt verba Iob <chapter eID="Job.31"/><div eID="gen526" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen527" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Job.32" sID="Job.32"/>
nescio enim quamdiu subsistam et si post modicum tollat me factor meus <chapter eID="Job.32"/><div eID="gen527" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen528" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Job.33" sID="Job.33"/>
quod si non habes audi me tace et docebo te sapientiam <chapter eID="Job.33"/><div eID="gen528" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen529" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Job.34" sID="Job.34"/>
quia addit super peccata sua blasphemiam inter nos interim constringatur et tunc ad iudicium provocet sermonibus suis Deum <chapter eID="Job.34"/><div eID="gen529" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen530" type="x-p"/><chapter n="35" osisID="Job.35" sID="Job.35"/>
ergo Iob frustra aperit os suum et absque scientia verba multiplicat <chapter eID="Job.35"/><div eID="gen530" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen531" type="x-p"/><chapter n="36" osisID="Job.36" sID="Job.36"/>
adnuntiat de ea amico suo quod possessio eius sit et ad eam possit ascendere <chapter eID="Job.36"/><div eID="gen531" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen532" type="x-p"/><chapter n="37" osisID="Job.37" sID="Job.37"/>
ideo timebunt eum viri et non audebunt contemplari omnes qui sibi videntur esse sapientes <chapter eID="Job.37"/><div eID="gen532" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen533" type="x-p"/><chapter n="38" osisID="Job.38" sID="Job.38"/>
quis praeparat corvo escam suam quando pulli eius ad Deum clamant vagantes eo quod non habeant cibos <chapter eID="Job.38"/><div eID="gen533" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen534" type="x-p"/><chapter n="39" osisID="Job.39" sID="Job.39"/>
unum locutus sum quod utinam non dixissem et alterum quibus ultra non addam <chapter eID="Job.39"/><div eID="gen534" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen535" type="x-p"/><chapter n="40" osisID="Job.40" sID="Job.40"/>
ecce spes eius frustrabitur eum et videntibus cunctis praecipitabitur <chapter eID="Job.40"/><div eID="gen535" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen536" type="x-p"/><chapter n="41" osisID="Job.41" sID="Job.41"/>
omne sublime videt ipse est rex super universos filios superbiae <chapter eID="Job.41"/><div eID="gen536" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen537" type="x-p"/><chapter n="42" osisID="Job.42" sID="Job.42"/>

vixit autem Iob post haec centum quadraginta annis et vidit filios suos et filios filiorum suorum usque ad quartam generationem et mortuus est senex et plenus dierum <chapter eID="Job.42"/><div eID="gen537" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen495" osisID="Job" type="book"/>

<div sID="gen732" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Eccl.9" sID="Eccl.9"/>

<div sID="gen733" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Eccl.10" sID="Eccl.10"/>

in cogitatione tua regi ne detrahas et in secreto cubiculi tui ne maledixeris diviti quia avis caeli portabit vocem tuam et qui habet pinnas adnuntiabit sententiam <chapter eID="Eccl.10"/><div eID="gen733" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen734" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Eccl.11" sID="Eccl.11"/>
aufer iram a corde tuo et amove malitiam a carne tua adulescentia enim et voluptas vana sunt <chapter eID="Eccl.11"/><div eID="gen734" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen735" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Eccl.12" sID="Eccl.12"/>

tigna domorum nostrarum cedrina laquearia nostra cypressina <chapter eID="Song.1"/><div eID="gen737" type="x-p"/>

egredimini et videte filiae Sion regem Salomonem in diademate quo coronavit eum mater sua in die disponsionis illius et in die laetitiae cordis eius <chapter eID="Song.3"/><div eID="gen739" type="x-p"/>
surge aquilo et veni auster perfla hortum meum et fluant aromata illius <chapter eID="Song.4"/><div eID="gen740" type="x-p"/>
quo abiit dilectus tuus o pulcherrima mulierum quo declinavit dilectus tuus et quaeremus eum tecum <chapter eID="Song.5"/><div eID="gen741" type="x-p"/>
revertere revertere Sulamitis revertere revertere ut intueamur te <chapter eID="Song.6"/><div eID="gen742" type="x-p"/>

<chapter n="1" osisID="Wis.1" sID="Wis.1"/>

impii autem manibus et verbis arcessierunt illam et aestimantes illam amicam defluxerunt et sponsionem posuerunt ad illam quoniam digni sunt qui sunt ex parte illius <chapter eID="Wis.1"/><div eID="gen746" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen747" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Wis.2" sID="Wis.2"/>
imitantur autem illum qui sunt ex parte illius <chapter eID="Wis.2"/><div eID="gen747" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen748" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Wis.3" sID="Wis.3"/>
nationis enim iniquae dirae sunt consummationes <chapter eID="Wis.3"/><div eID="gen748" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen749" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Wis.4" sID="Wis.4"/>
venient in cogitatione peccatorum suorum timidi et traducent illos ex adverso iniquitates ipsorum <chapter eID="Wis.4"/><div eID="gen749" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen750" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Wis.5" sID="Wis.5"/>

contra illos stabit spiritus virtutis et tamquam turbedo venti dividet illos et ad heremiam perducet omnem terram iniquitatis et malignitas evertet sedes potentium <chapter eID="Wis.5"/><div eID="gen750" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen751" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Wis.6" sID="Wis.6"/>
ergo accipite disciplinam per sermones meos et proderit vobis <chapter eID="Wis.6"/><div eID="gen751" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen752" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Wis.7" sID="Wis.7"/>
illi enim succedit nox sapientiam autem non vincit malitia <chapter eID="Wis.7"/><div eID="gen752" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen753" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Wis.8" sID="Wis.8"/>

et ut scivi quoniam aliter non possum esse continens nisi Deus det et hoc ipsum erat sapientiae scire cuius esset hoc donum adii Dominum et deprecatus sum illum et dixi ex totis praecordiis meis <chapter eID="Wis.8"/><div eID="gen753" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen754" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Wis.9" sID="Wis.9"/>
et per sapientiam sanati sunt <chapter eID="Wis.9"/><div eID="gen754" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen755" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Wis.10" sID="Wis.10"/>
quoniam sapientia aperuit os mutorum et linguas infantium fecit dissertas <chapter eID="Wis.10"/><div eID="gen755" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen756" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Wis.11" sID="Wis.11"/>
parcis autem omnibus quoniam tua sunt Domine qui animas amas <chapter eID="Wis.11"/><div eID="gen756" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen757" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Wis.12" sID="Wis.12"/>

in his enim quae patiebantur moleste ferebant in quibus patientes indignabantur per haec quos putabant deos in ipsis cum exterminarentur videntes illum quem olim negabant se nosse Deum verum agnoverunt propter quod et finis condemnationis illis veniet <chapter eID="Wis.12"/><div eID="gen757" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen758" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Wis.13" sID="Wis.13"/>

et pro itinere petit ab hoc qui ambulare non potest et de adquirendo et de operando et de omnium rerum eventu petit ab eo qui in omnibus est inutilis <chapter eID="Wis.13"/><div eID="gen758" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen759" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Wis.14" sID="Wis.14"/>
non enim iurantium est virtus sed peccantium poena perambulat semper in iniustorum praevaricationem <chapter eID="Wis.14"/><div eID="gen759" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen760" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Wis.15" sID="Wis.15"/>
sed nec aspectu aliquis ex his animalibus bona potest conspicere effugit autem Dei laudem et benedictionem eius <chapter eID="Wis.15"/><div eID="gen760" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen761" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Wis.16" sID="Wis.16"/>
ingrati enim fides tamquam hibernalis glacies tabescit et disperiet tamquam aqua supervacua <chapter eID="Wis.16"/><div eID="gen761" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen762" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Wis.17" sID="Wis.17"/>
solis autem illis superposita erat gravis nox imago tenebrarum quae superventura illis erat ipsi ergo sibi erant graviores tenebris <chapter eID="Wis.17"/><div eID="gen762" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen763" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Wis.18" sID="Wis.18"/>

<div sID="gen764" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Wis.19" sID="Wis.19"/>

flammae e contrario corruptibilium animalium non vexaverunt carnes coambulantium nec dissolvebant illam quae facile dissolvitur sicut glacies bonam escam in omnibus enim Domine magnificasti populum tuum et honorasti et non despexisti in omni tempore et in omni loco adsistens eis <chapter eID="Wis.19"/><div eID="gen764" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen745" osisID="Wis" type="book"/>

SIR.textOutsideVerses: multorum nobis et magnorum per Legem et Prophetas aliosque qui secuti sunt illos sapientiam demonstratam, in quibus oportet laudare Israhel doctrinae et sapientiae causa; quia non solum ipsos loquentes necesse est peritos, sed etiam extraneos posse et dicentes et scribentes doctissimos fieri. avus meus Iesus postquam se amplius dedit ad diligentiam lectionis Legis et Prophetarum et aliorum librorum qui nobis a parentibus nostris traditi sunt, volui et ipse scribere aliquid horum quae ad doctrinam et sapientiam pertinent, ut desiderantes discere et illorum periti facti magis magisque adtendant animo et confirmentur ad legitimam vitam. hortor itaque venire vos cum benevolentia et adtentiore studio lectionem facere, et veniam habere in illis in quibus videmur sequentes imaginem sapientiae et deficere in verborum conpositione. nam deficiunt verba hebraica quando translata fuerint ad alteram linguam; non solum autem haec, sed et ipsa Lex et Prophetae ceteraque librorum non parvam habent differentiam quando inter se dicuntur. nam in octavo et tricesimo anno temporibus Ptolomei Euergetis regis, postquam perveni in Aegyptum et cum multum temporis ibi fecissem, inveni libros relictos non parvae neque contemnendae doctrinae. itaque bonum et necessarium putavi et ipse aliquam addere diligentiam et laborem interpretandi istum librum; et multa vigilia adtuli doctrinam in spatio temporis, ad illa quae ad finem ducunt librum dare, et illis qui volunt animum intendere et discere quemadmodum oporteat instituere mores qui secundum legem Domini proposuerunt vitam agere.

<div sID="gen770" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Sir.4" sID="Sir.4"/>

<div sID="gen773" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Sir.7" sID="Sir.7"/>

<div sID="gen774" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Sir.8" sID="Sir.8"/>

<div sID="gen775" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Sir.9" sID="Sir.9"/>

<div sID="gen776" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Sir.10" sID="Sir.10"/>

<div sID="gen777" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Sir.11" sID="Sir.11"/>

<div sID="gen778" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Sir.12" sID="Sir.12"/>

<div sID="gen779" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Sir.13" sID="Sir.13"/>

<div sID="gen780" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Sir.14" sID="Sir.14"/>
protegetur in subtegmine illius a fervore et in gloria eius requiescet <chapter eID="Sir.14"/><div eID="gen780" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen781" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Sir.15" sID="Sir.15"/>

<div sID="gen782" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Sir.16" sID="Sir.16"/>

<div sID="gen783" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Sir.17" sID="Sir.17"/>

<div sID="gen785" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Sir.19" sID="Sir.19"/>

<div sID="gen786" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Sir.20" sID="Sir.20"/>

<div sID="gen788" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Sir.22" sID="Sir.22"/>

<div sID="gen790" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Sir.24" sID="Sir.24"/>

uniuscuiusque confirmavit bona et quis satiabitur videns gloriam eius <chapter eID="Sir.42"/><div eID="gen808" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen809" type="x-p"/><chapter n="43" osisID="Sir.43" sID="Sir.43"/>
omnia autem Dominus fecit et pie agentibus dedit sapientiam <chapter eID="Sir.43"/><div eID="gen809" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen810" type="x-p"/><chapter n="44" osisID="Sir.44" sID="Sir.44"/>
et conservavit illis homines misericordiae invenientes gratiam in oculis omnis carnis <chapter eID="Sir.44"/><div eID="gen810" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen811" type="x-p"/><chapter n="45" osisID="Sir.45" sID="Sir.45"/>

et testamentum David regi filio Iesse de tribu Iuda hereditas ipsi et semini eius ut daret sapientiam in cor nostrum iudicare gentem suam in iustitia ne abolerentur bona ipsorum et gloriam eorum in gentem ipsorum aeternam fecit <chapter eID="Sir.45"/><div eID="gen811" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen812" type="x-p"/><chapter n="46" osisID="Sir.46" sID="Sir.46"/>
et post hoc dormivit et notum fecit regi et ostendit illi finem vitae suae et exaltavit vocem eius de terra in prophetia delere impietatem gentis <chapter eID="Sir.46"/><div eID="gen812" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen813" type="x-p"/><chapter n="47" osisID="Sir.47" sID="Sir.47"/>
et quaesivit omnes nequitias usque dum perveniret ad illos defensio et ab omnibus peccatis liberavit eos <chapter eID="Sir.47"/><div eID="gen813" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen814" type="x-p"/><chapter n="48" osisID="Sir.48" sID="Sir.48"/>
ostendit futura et abscondita antequam evenirent <chapter eID="Sir.48"/><div eID="gen814" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen815" type="x-p"/><chapter n="49" osisID="Sir.49" sID="Sir.49"/>
Seth et Sem apud homines gloriam adepti sunt et super omnem animam in origine Adam <chapter eID="Sir.49"/><div eID="gen815" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen816" type="x-p"/><chapter n="50" osisID="Sir.50" sID="Sir.50"/>
si enim haec fecerit ad omnia valebit quia lux Dei vestigium eius est <chapter eID="Sir.50"/><div eID="gen816" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen817" type="x-p"/><chapter n="51" osisID="Sir.51" sID="Sir.51"/>

operamini opus vestrum ante tempus et dabit vobis mercedem vestram in tempore suo <milestone n="52 " type="x-usfm-ca"/><div eID="gen817" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen818" type="x-p"/><milestone n="1" type="x-usfm-va"/> et declinavit Salomon genua in conspectu totius ecclesiae Israhel et aperuit manus suas ad caelum et dixit<milestone n="2" type="x-usfm-va"/> Domine Deus Israhel non est tibi similis Deus in caelo sursum neque in terra deorsum<milestone n="3" type="x-usfm-va"/> qui custodis testamentum tuum et misericordiam pueris tuis euntibus in conspectu tuo in toto corde<milestone n="4" type="x-usfm-va"/> servans puero tuo David quae locutus es illi et locutus es in ore tuo et in manu tua supplesti quasi dies iste<milestone n="5" type="x-usfm-va"/> et nunc Domine Deus Israhel custodi puero tuo David quae locutus es illi dicens non deerit tibi vir a facie mea sedens in throno Israhel<milestone n="6" type="x-usfm-va"/> verum si custodierint filii tui manum suam ut in praeceptis meis ambulent sicut ambulaverunt in conspectu meo<milestone n="7" type="x-usfm-va"/> et nunc Domine Deus Israhel creditum est verbum quod locutus es puero tuo David<milestone n="8" type="x-usfm-va"/> quoniam si vere habitabit Deus cum hominibus in terra<milestone n="9" type="x-usfm-va"/> si caelum caeli non sufficit verum domus quam aedificavi<milestone n="10" type="x-usfm-va"/> et respicias ad orationem pueri tui et precationem Domine ut exaudias placationem orationis quam puer tuus orat coram te<milestone n="11" type="x-usfm-va"/> ut sint oculi tui super domum hanc die et nocte in locum quem dixisti invocari nomen tuum et exaudias orationem quam puer tuus orat in hunc locum<milestone n="12" type="x-usfm-va"/> et exaudias precationem pueri tui et populi tui Israhel si oraverint in loco isto  <chapter eID="Sir.51"/><div eID="gen818" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen765" osisID="Sir" type="book"/>

ISA.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Isa" sID="gen819" type="book"/> <milestone n="Isaias" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Isaias" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Is" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Isaias</title> <div sID="gen820" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Isa.1" sID="Isa.1"/>
et erit fortitudo vestra ut favilla stuppae et opus vestrum quasi scintilla et succendetur utrumque simul et non erit qui extinguat <chapter eID="Isa.1"/><div eID="gen820" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen821" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Isa.2" sID="Isa.2"/>
quiescite ergo ab homine cuius spiritus in naribus eius quia excelsus reputatus est ipse <chapter eID="Isa.2"/><div eID="gen821" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen822" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Isa.3" sID="Isa.3"/>
et maerebunt atque lugebunt portae eius et desolata in terra sedebit <chapter eID="Isa.3"/><div eID="gen822" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen823" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Isa.4" sID="Isa.4"/>
et tabernaculum erit in umbraculum diei ab aestu et in securitatem et absconsionem a turbine et a pluvia <chapter eID="Isa.4"/><div eID="gen823" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen824" type="x-p"/><chapter n="5" osisID="Isa.5" sID="Isa.5"/>
et sonabit super eum in die illa sicut sonitus maris aspiciemus in terram et ecce tenebrae tribulationis et lux obtenebrata est in caligine eius <chapter eID="Isa.5"/><div eID="gen824" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen825" type="x-p"/><chapter n="6" osisID="Isa.6" sID="Isa.6"/>

et adhuc in ea decimatio et convertetur et erit in ostensionem sicut terebinthus et sicuti quercus quae expandit ramos suos semen sanctum erit id quod steterit in ea <chapter eID="Isa.6"/><div eID="gen825" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen826" type="x-p"/><chapter n="7" osisID="Isa.7" sID="Isa.7"/>
et omnes montes qui in sarculo sarientur non veniet illuc terror spinarum et veprium et erit in pascua bovis et in conculcationem pecoris <chapter eID="Isa.7"/><div eID="gen826" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen827" type="x-p"/><chapter n="8" osisID="Isa.8" sID="Isa.8"/>
et ad terram intuebitur et ecce tribulatio et tenebrae dissolutio angustia et caligo persequens et non poterit avolare de angustia sua <chapter eID="Isa.8"/><div eID="gen827" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen828" type="x-p"/><chapter n="9" osisID="Isa.9" sID="Isa.9"/>
in omnibus his non est aversus furor eius sed adhuc manus eius extenta <chapter eID="Isa.9"/><div eID="gen828" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen829" type="x-p"/><chapter n="10" osisID="Isa.10" sID="Isa.10"/>
et subvertentur condensa saltus ferro et Libanus cum excelsis cadet <chapter eID="Isa.10"/><div eID="gen829" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen830" type="x-p"/><chapter n="11" osisID="Isa.11" sID="Isa.11"/>
et erit via residuo populo meo qui relinquetur ab Assyriis sicut fuit Israhel in die qua ascendit de terra Aegypti <chapter eID="Isa.11"/><div eID="gen830" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen831" type="x-p"/><chapter n="12" osisID="Isa.12" sID="Isa.12"/>
exulta et lauda habitatio Sion quia magnus in medio tui Sanctus Israhel <chapter eID="Isa.12"/><div eID="gen831" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen832" type="x-p"/><chapter n="13" osisID="Isa.13" sID="Isa.13"/>
et respondebunt ibi ululae in aedibus eius et sirenae in delubris voluptatis <chapter eID="Isa.13"/><div eID="gen832" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen833" type="x-p"/><chapter n="14" osisID="Isa.14" sID="Isa.14"/>
et quid respondebitur nuntiis gentis quia Dominus fundavit Sion et in ipsa sperabunt pauperes populi eius <chapter eID="Isa.14"/><div eID="gen833" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen834" type="x-p"/><chapter n="15" osisID="Isa.15" sID="Isa.15"/>
quia aquae Dibon repletae sunt sanguine ponam enim super Dibon additamenta his qui fugerint de Moab leonem et reliquiis terrae <chapter eID="Isa.15"/><div eID="gen834" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen835" type="x-p"/><chapter n="16" osisID="Isa.16" sID="Isa.16"/>

et nunc locutus est Dominus dicens in tribus annis quasi anni mercennarii auferetur gloria Moab super omni populo multo et relinquetur parvus et modicus nequaquam multus <chapter eID="Isa.16"/><div eID="gen835" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen836" type="x-p"/><chapter n="17" osisID="Isa.17" sID="Isa.17"/>
in tempore vespere et ecce turbatio in matutino et non subsistet haec est pars eorum qui vastaverunt nos et sors diripientium nos <chapter eID="Isa.17"/><div eID="gen836" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen837" type="x-p"/><chapter n="18" osisID="Isa.18" sID="Isa.18"/>

in tempore illo deferetur munus Domino exercituum a populo divulso et dilacerato a populo terribili post quem non fuit alius a gente expectante expectante et conculcata cuius diripuerunt flumina terram eius ad locum nominis Domini exercituum montem Sion <chapter eID="Isa.18"/><div eID="gen837" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen838" type="x-p"/><chapter n="19" osisID="Isa.19" sID="Isa.19"/>
cui benedixit Dominus exercituum dicens benedictus populus meus Aegypti et opus manuum mearum Assyrio hereditas autem mea Israhel <chapter eID="Isa.19"/><div eID="gen838" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen839" type="x-p"/><chapter n="20" osisID="Isa.20" sID="Isa.20"/>

et dicet habitator insulae huius in die illa ecce haec erat spes nostra ad quos confugimus in auxilium ut liberaret nos a facie regis Assyriorum et quomodo effugere poterimus nos <chapter eID="Isa.20"/><div eID="gen839" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen840" type="x-p"/><chapter n="21" osisID="Isa.21" sID="Isa.21"/>
et reliquiae numeri sagittariorum fortium de filiis Cedar inminuentur Dominus enim Deus Israhel locutus est <chapter eID="Isa.21"/><div eID="gen840" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen841" type="x-p"/><chapter n="22" osisID="Isa.22" sID="Isa.22"/>

in die illo dicit Dominus exercituum auferetur paxillus qui fixus fuerat in loco fideli et frangetur et cadet et peribit quod pependerat in eo quia Dominus locutus est <chapter eID="Isa.22"/><div eID="gen841" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen842" type="x-p"/><chapter n="23" osisID="Isa.23" sID="Isa.23"/>

et erunt negotiatio eius et mercedes eius sanctificatae Domino non condentur neque reponentur quia his qui habitaverint coram Domino erit negotiatio eius ut manducent in saturitatem et vestiantur usque ad vetustatem <chapter eID="Isa.23"/><div eID="gen842" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen843" type="x-p"/><chapter n="24" osisID="Isa.24" sID="Isa.24"/>

et erubescet luna et confundetur sol cum regnaverit Dominus exercituum in monte Sion et in Hierusalem et in conspectu senum suorum fuerit glorificatus <chapter eID="Isa.24"/><div eID="gen843" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen844" type="x-p"/><chapter n="25" osisID="Isa.25" sID="Isa.25"/>
et munimenta sublimium murorum tuorum concident et humiliabuntur et detrahentur in terram usque ad pulverem <chapter eID="Isa.25"/><div eID="gen844" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen845" type="x-p"/><chapter n="26" osisID="Isa.26" sID="Isa.26"/>

ecce enim Dominus egreditur de loco suo ut visitet iniquitatem habitatoris terrae contra eum et revelabit terra sanguinem suum et non operiet ultra interfectos suos <chapter eID="Isa.26"/><div eID="gen845" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen846" type="x-p"/><chapter n="27" osisID="Isa.27" sID="Isa.27"/>

et erit in die illa clangetur in tuba magna et venient qui perditi fuerant de terra Assyriorum et qui eiecti erant in terra Aegypti et adorabunt Dominum in monte sancto in Hierusalem <chapter eID="Isa.27"/><div eID="gen846" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen847" type="x-p"/><chapter n="28" osisID="Isa.28" sID="Isa.28"/>
et hoc a Domino Deo exercituum exivit ut mirabile faceret consilium et magnificaret iustitiam <chapter eID="Isa.28"/><div eID="gen847" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen848" type="x-p"/><chapter n="29" osisID="Isa.29" sID="Isa.29"/>
et scient errantes spiritu intellectum et mussitatores discent legem <chapter eID="Isa.29"/><div eID="gen848" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen849" type="x-p"/><chapter n="30" osisID="Isa.30" sID="Isa.30"/>

praeparata est enim ab heri Thofeth a rege praeparata profunda et dilatata nutrimenta eius ignis et ligna multa flatus Domini sicut torrens sulphuris succendens eam <chapter eID="Isa.30"/><div eID="gen849" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen850" type="x-p"/><chapter n="31" osisID="Isa.31" sID="Isa.31"/>
et fortitudo eius a terrore transibit et pavebunt fugientes principes eius dixit Dominus cuius ignis est in Sion et caminus eius in Hierusalem <chapter eID="Isa.31"/><div eID="gen850" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen851" type="x-p"/><chapter n="32" osisID="Isa.32" sID="Isa.32"/>
beati qui seminatis super omnes aquas inmittentes pedem bovis et asini <chapter eID="Isa.32"/><div eID="gen851" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen852" type="x-p"/><chapter n="33" osisID="Isa.33" sID="Isa.33"/>
nec dicet vicinus elangui populus qui habitat in ea auferetur ab eo iniquitas <chapter eID="Isa.33"/><div eID="gen852" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen853" type="x-p"/><chapter n="34" osisID="Isa.34" sID="Isa.34"/>

et ipse misit eis sortem et manus eius divisit eam illis in mensuram usque in aeternum possidebunt eam in generatione et generatione habitabunt in ea <chapter eID="Isa.34"/><div eID="gen853" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen854" type="x-p"/><chapter n="35" osisID="Isa.35" sID="Isa.35"/>

et redempti a Domino convertentur et venient in Sion cum laude et laetitia sempiterna super caput eorum gaudium et laetitiam obtinebunt et fugiet dolor et gemitus <chapter eID="Isa.35"/><div eID="gen854" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen855" type="x-p"/><chapter n="36" osisID="Isa.36" sID="Isa.36"/>

et ingressus est Eliachim filius Helciae qui erat super domum et Sobna scriba et Ioae filius Asaph a commentariis ad Ezechiam scissis vestibus et nuntiaverunt ei verba Rabsacis <chapter eID="Isa.36"/><div eID="gen855" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen856" type="x-p"/><chapter n="37" osisID="Isa.37" sID="Isa.37"/>

et factum est cum adoraret in templo Nesrach deum suum Adramelech et Sarasar filii eius percusserunt eum gladio fugeruntque in terram Ararat et regnavit Asoraddon filius eius pro eo <chapter eID="Isa.37"/><div eID="gen856" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen857" type="x-p"/><chapter n="38" osisID="Isa.38" sID="Isa.38"/>
et dixit Ezechias quod erit signum quia ascendam in domo Domini <chapter eID="Isa.38"/><div eID="gen857" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen858" type="x-p"/><chapter n="39" osisID="Isa.39" sID="Isa.39"/>
et dixit Ezechias ad Isaiam bonum verbum Domini quod locutus est et dixit fiat tantum pax et veritas in diebus meis <chapter eID="Isa.39"/><div eID="gen858" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen859" type="x-p"/><chapter n="40" osisID="Isa.40" sID="Isa.40"/>
qui autem sperant in Domino mutabunt fortitudinem adsument pinnas sicut aquilae current et non laborabunt ambulabunt et non deficient <chapter eID="Isa.40"/><div eID="gen859" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen860" type="x-p"/><chapter n="41" osisID="Isa.41" sID="Isa.41"/>
ecce omnes iniusti et vana opera eorum ventus et inane simulacra eorum <chapter eID="Isa.41"/><div eID="gen860" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen861" type="x-p"/><chapter n="42" osisID="Isa.42" sID="Isa.42"/>
et effudit super eum indignationem furoris sui et forte bellum et conbusit eum in circuitu et non cognovit et succendit eum et non intellexit <chapter eID="Isa.42"/><div eID="gen861" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen862" type="x-p"/><chapter n="43" osisID="Isa.43" sID="Isa.43"/>
et contaminavi principes sanctos dedi ad internicionem Iacob et Israhel in blasphemiam <chapter eID="Isa.43"/><div eID="gen862" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen863" type="x-p"/><chapter n="44" osisID="Isa.44" sID="Isa.44"/>
qui dico Cyro pastor meus es et omnem voluntatem meam conplebis qui dico Hierusalem aedificaberis et templo fundaberis <chapter eID="Isa.44"/><div eID="gen863" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen864" type="x-p"/><chapter n="45" osisID="Isa.45" sID="Isa.45"/>
in Domino iustificabitur et laudabitur omne semen Israhel <chapter eID="Isa.45"/><div eID="gen864" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen865" type="x-p"/><chapter n="46" osisID="Isa.46" sID="Isa.46"/>
prope feci iustitiam meam non elongabitur et salus mea non morabitur dabo in Sion salutem et Israheli gloriam meam <chapter eID="Isa.46"/><div eID="gen865" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen866" type="x-p"/><chapter n="47" osisID="Isa.47" sID="Isa.47"/>
sic facta sunt tibi in quibuscumque laboraveras negotiatores tui ab adulescentia tua unusquisque in via sua erraverunt non est qui salvet te <chapter eID="Isa.47"/><div eID="gen866" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen867" type="x-p"/><chapter n="48" osisID="Isa.48" sID="Isa.48"/>
non est pax dicit Dominus impiis <chapter eID="Isa.48"/><div eID="gen867" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen868" type="x-p"/><chapter n="49" osisID="Isa.49" sID="Isa.49"/>

et cibabo hostes tuos carnibus suis et quasi musto sanguine suo inebriabuntur et sciet omnis caro quia ego Dominus salvans te et redemptor tuus Fortis Iacob <chapter eID="Isa.49"/><div eID="gen868" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen869" type="x-p"/><chapter n="50" osisID="Isa.50" sID="Isa.50"/>

ecce omnes vos accendentes ignem accincti flammis ambulate in lumine ignis vestri et in flammis quas succendistis de manu mea factum est hoc vobis in doloribus dormietis <chapter eID="Isa.50"/><div eID="gen869" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen870" type="x-p"/><chapter n="51" osisID="Isa.51" sID="Isa.51"/>

et ponam illud in manu eorum qui te humiliaverunt et dixerunt animae tuae incurvare ut transeamus et posuisti ut terram corpus tuum et quasi viam transeuntibus <chapter eID="Isa.51"/><div eID="gen870" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen871" type="x-p"/><chapter n="52" osisID="Isa.52" sID="Isa.52"/>

iste asperget gentes multas super ipsum continebunt reges os suum quia quibus non est narratum de eo viderunt et qui non audierunt contemplati sunt <chapter eID="Isa.52"/><div eID="gen871" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen872" type="x-p"/><chapter n="53" osisID="Isa.53" sID="Isa.53"/>

ideo dispertiam ei plurimos et fortium dividet spolia pro eo quod tradidit in morte animam suam et cum sceleratis reputatus est et ipse peccatum multorum tulit et pro transgressoribus rogavit <chapter eID="Isa.53"/><div eID="gen872" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen873" type="x-p"/><chapter n="54" osisID="Isa.54" sID="Isa.54"/>

omne vas quod fictum est contra te non dirigetur et omnem linguam resistentem tibi in iudicio iudicabis haec hereditas servorum Domini et iustitia eorum apud me dicit Dominus <chapter eID="Isa.54"/><div eID="gen873" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen874" type="x-p"/><chapter n="55" osisID="Isa.55" sID="Isa.55"/>
pro saliunca ascendet abies et pro urtica crescet myrtus et erit Dominus nominatus in signum aeternum quod non auferetur <chapter eID="Isa.55"/><div eID="gen874" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen875" type="x-p"/><chapter n="56" osisID="Isa.56" sID="Isa.56"/>
venite sumamus vinum et impleamur ebrietate et erit sicut hodie sic et cras et multo amplius <chapter eID="Isa.56"/><div eID="gen875" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen876" type="x-p"/><chapter n="57" osisID="Isa.57" sID="Isa.57"/>
non est pax dixit Deus meus impiis <chapter eID="Isa.57"/><div eID="gen876" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen877" type="x-p"/><chapter n="58" osisID="Isa.58" sID="Isa.58"/>
tunc delectaberis super Domino et sustollam te super altitudines terrae et cibabo te hereditate Iacob patris tui os enim Domini locutum est <chapter eID="Isa.58"/><div eID="gen877" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen878" type="x-p"/><chapter n="59" osisID="Isa.59" sID="Isa.59"/>

hoc foedus meum cum eis dicit Dominus spiritus meus qui est in te et verba mea quae posui in ore tuo non recedent de ore tuo et de ore seminis tui et de ore seminis seminis tui dixit Dominus amodo et usque in sempiternum <chapter eID="Isa.59"/><div eID="gen878" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen879" type="x-p"/><chapter n="60" osisID="Isa.60" sID="Isa.60"/>
minimus erit in mille et parvulus in gentem fortissimam ego Dominus in tempore eius subito faciam istud <chapter eID="Isa.60"/><div eID="gen879" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen880" type="x-p"/><chapter n="61" osisID="Isa.61" sID="Isa.61"/>
sicut enim terra profert germen suum et sicut hortus semen suum germinat sic Dominus Deus germinabit iustitiam et laudem coram universis gentibus <chapter eID="Isa.61"/><div eID="gen880" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen881" type="x-p"/><chapter n="62" osisID="Isa.62" sID="Isa.62"/>
et vocabunt eos Populus sanctus Redempti a Domino tu autem vocaberis Quaesita civitas et non Derelicta <chapter eID="Isa.62"/><div eID="gen881" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen882" type="x-p"/><chapter n="63" osisID="Isa.63" sID="Isa.63"/>
facti sumus quasi in principio cum non dominareris nostri neque invocaretur nomen tuum super nos <chapter eID="Isa.63"/><div eID="gen882" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen883" type="x-p"/><chapter n="64" osisID="Isa.64" sID="Isa.64"/>
numquid super his continebis te Domine tacebis et adfliges nos vehementer <chapter eID="Isa.64"/><div eID="gen883" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen884" type="x-p"/><chapter n="65" osisID="Isa.65" sID="Isa.65"/>

lupus et agnus pascentur simul et leo et bos comedent paleas et serpenti pulvis panis eius non nocebunt neque occident in omni monte sancto meo dicit Dominus <chapter eID="Isa.65"/><div eID="gen884" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen885" type="x-p"/><chapter n="66" osisID="Isa.66" sID="Isa.66"/>

et egredientur et videbunt cadavera virorum qui praevaricati sunt in me vermis eorum non morietur et ignis eorum non extinguetur et erunt usque ad satietatem visionis omni carni <chapter eID="Isa.66"/><div eID="gen885" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen819" osisID="Isa" type="book"/>

JER.rawOSIS: <div canonical="true" osisID="Jer" sID="gen886" type="book"/> <milestone n="Ieremias" type="x-usfm-h"/> <milestone n="" type="x-usfm-toc1"/> <milestone n="Ieremias" type="x-usfm-toc2"/> <milestone n="Ier" type="x-usfm-toc3"/> <title type="main">Ieremias</title> <div sID="gen887" type="x-p"/>
<chapter n="1" osisID="Jer.1" sID="Jer.1"/>
et bellabunt adversum te et non praevalebunt quia tecum ego sum ait Dominus ut liberem te <chapter eID="Jer.1"/><div eID="gen887" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen888" type="x-p"/><chapter n="2" osisID="Jer.2" sID="Jer.2"/>
nam et ab ista egredieris et manus tuae erunt super caput tuum quoniam obtrivit Dominus confidentiam tuam et nihil habebis prosperum <chapter eID="Jer.2"/><div eID="gen888" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen889" type="x-p"/><chapter n="3" osisID="Jer.3" sID="Jer.3"/>

dormiemus in confusione nostra et operiet nos ignominia nostra quoniam Domino Deo nostro peccavimus nos et patres nostri ab adulescentia nostra usque ad hanc diem et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri <chapter eID="Jer.3"/><div eID="gen889" type="x-p"/>
<div sID="gen890" type="x-p"/><chapter n="4" osisID="Jer.4" sID="Jer.4"/>
